job.title: Sr. Accountant
job.description:
Sr. Accountant

Overview

A growing organization is seeking a detail-oriented Sr. Accountant to provide critical support across month-end close, financial reporting, reconciliations, audit coordination, and technical accounting. This fully remote contract opportunity is ideal for an accounting professional who can manage complex processes, investigate variances, and help improve accounting workflows in a fast-paced environment.

Required Skills

  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes while meeting established financial deadlines.
  • Record and review payroll, intercompany activity, and other close-related transactions.
  • Prepare and review consolidated financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Perform complex account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies and variances.
  • Support external audits by coordinating documentation and helping ensure compliance with internal controls.
  • Research and apply relevant accounting standards to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Identify and implement improvements to accounting processes, workflows, and software utilization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with NetSuite; NetSuite experience is required.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including PivotTables and VLOOKUPs.
  • Experience using enterprise-level ERP systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, and organizational skills.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in professional services or advertising.
  • Familiarity with project-based accounting or revenue recognition.
  • Experience working in a mid-to-large-sized organization with complex business structures.
  • Experience in a publicly traded company.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and SEC reporting requirements.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Four to six years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience supporting financial close, reporting, reconciliations, audits, and technical accounting activities.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Must be available to work Pacific Time hours, generally 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PT.
  • Contract duration is approximately three months or longer.
  • Ability to start as soon as possible.

job.title: Technical PM
job.description:
Technical Program Manager, Site Implementations

Overview

Lead complex, high-impact technology implementations that bring integrated parking solutions to life at new and existing sites. As the Technical Program Manager, you will own each deployment from discovery and kickoff through design, permitting, installation, software configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and operational handoff.

This role brings together software, customer-facing hardware, networking, construction, vendors, field teams, and customer operations. You will establish repeatable implementation standards, coordinate cross-functional delivery, manage site readiness, and ensure each launch meets approved scope, quality standards, acceptance criteria, and operational requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience leading complex technology implementations involving software, customer-facing hardware, networking, vendors, and physical site work.
  • Demonstrated ownership of multiple site deployments from initial planning through go-live.
  • Experience managing:
  • Permitting and inspections
  • Construction and site-readiness dependencies
  • Vendor schedules and contractor commitments
  • Procurement, shipping, and equipment installation
  • Quality assurance and customer acceptance
  • Strong working knowledge of software delivery, integrations, defect management, release readiness, and production support.
  • Ability to interpret implementation plans, site drawings, technical requirements, test results, and project financial information well enough to identify gaps and drive decisions.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, organization, risk management, and executive status-reporting skills.
  • Ability to coordinate internal teams, customers, hardware vendors, software teams, utilities, permitting authorities, construction partners, low-voltage contractors, and field installers.
  • Experience managing risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, scope changes, budget impacts, dependencies, and recovery plans.
  • Ability to coordinate functional testing, integration testing, field acceptance testing, user acceptance testing, defect remediation, launch approval, and post-launch support.
  • Ability to travel regularly to implementation sites and support critical milestones outside normal business hours when required.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience with parking technology, access control, kiosks, point-of-sale systems, building systems, EV charging, security systems, telecommunications, or other distributed hardware and software environments.
  • Experience with Parking Access and Revenue Control Systems.
  • Familiarity with payment systems, license plate recognition, parking guidance, enforcement, mobile applications, or revenue optimization products.
  • Experience supporting implementations at municipalities, hospitals, hotels, universities, mixed-use properties, airports, or other active customer sites.
  • Project or program management certification.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or comparable project and program management tools.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred education: Not specified in the provided job details.
  • Preferred experience: Five or more years leading complex, multi-site technology implementations that combine software, hardware, networking, vendors, and physical site work.

Other Requirements

  • Regular travel to implementation sites is required.
  • This is a field-oriented implementation role involving active customer sites, installation environments, and coordination with construction, electrical, low-voltage, utility, permitting, and field service partners.
  • Availability to support critical implementation milestones outside normal business hours may be required.
  • The successful candidate will be expected to establish and continuously improve implementation playbooks, including stage gates, deliverables, decision rights, quality standards, escalation paths, and launch criteria.
  • Responsibilities include coordinating cutover and go-live plans, confirming training and support readiness, completing operational handoff documentation, and using post-launch findings to improve future implementations.

job.title: Software Engineer - Fleet Mapping
job.description:
Software Engineer – Fleet Mapping

Overview

Join a Perception team developing the systems that help autonomous vehicles understand and navigate complex environments. In this role, you will contribute to an offline mapping initiative focused on high-definition semantic maps—an essential component of enabling fully autonomous driving at scale. You will design, train, validate, and integrate machine learning models that detect semantic map elements, while helping build scalable pipelines that automate the mapping of new features.

This is a remote position for candidates located in California, with three openings available.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of professional experience with C++
  • Strong understanding of networking protocols, ideally including UDP
  • Experience working with highly resilient distributed systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to research, implement, and train machine learning models
  • Experience curating, validating, and labeling datasets for model training and validation
  • Ability to integrate models into broader software or data-processing pipelines
  • Strong collaboration skills, including the ability to work closely with validation teams

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in robotics
  • Experience with 3D computer vision
  • Experience with mapping systems or technologies
  • Experience working with machine learning infrastructure
  • Background automating new features within mapping or perception pipelines

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, robotics, or a related field is preferred; specific educational requirements were not provided.
  • 5+ years of professional C++ experience
  • Experience developing and deploying machine learning models in complex, distributed environments

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Location: California
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Start: ASAP

job.title: Technical Program Manager - Vehicle System Integration
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Vehicle System Integration

Overview

Lead the cross-functional execution behind a vehicle’s functional architecture as a Technical Program Manager supporting a Systems Engineering team. This role serves as the operational engine and technical coordinator responsible for translating high-level product definitions into safe, traceable, and technically sound system-level implementations.

You will partner with Systems Architects, Safety Specialists, Validation, Industrial Design, Product, Electrical and Software teams, Manufacturing, and other engineering stakeholders to drive requirements through validation. From managing System Technical Specification (STS) maturity and System Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (SFMEA) workflows to coordinating engineering changes and test asset configurations, you will help ensure complex vehicle systems remain aligned with program milestones and engineering objectives.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager or Systems Engineer in an aerospace, autonomous vehicle, or advanced automotive environment.
  • Proven success driving complex, cross-functional programs from requirements definition through validation.
  • Practical knowledge of the systems engineering V-model lifecycle, fail-operational architectures, and requirements management frameworks.
  • Experience managing safety workflows, including:
  • System Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (SFMEA)
  • Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA)
  • Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
  • ISO 26262 and/or MIL-STD-882 compliance processes
  • Strong background in vehicle electrical/electronic system design, electrical integration, or complex hardware/software interfaces.
  • Experience with project, change, and configuration management tools such as JIRA or Smartsheet.
  • Experience with requirements management tools and processes such as Jama, Polarion, or DOORS.
  • Ability to facilitate technical and non-technical discussions with highly specialized teams, including hardware, software, safety, and manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated ability to build consensus and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Strong risk identification, issue resolution, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to thrive in rapid design cycles and remain flexible and highly organized amid uncertainty.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience developing automotive systems in body or motion domains, such as:
  • Braking
  • Steering
  • Suspension
  • Body controllers
  • Experience coordinating system-level Engineering Change Requests (ECRs).
  • Experience developing dependency matrices across product development, styling and packaging, safety, vehicle systems, vehicle integration, and validation teams.
  • Experience defining or tracking test asset configurations and mapping requirements to validation environments.
  • Experience creating program health metrics related to requirement stability, SFMEA action-item closure, verification progress, and engineering maturity.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in technical program management or systems engineering within aerospace, autonomous vehicles, or advanced automotive development.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Foster City, California.
  • Engagement: W2 only.
  • Duration: 6 months.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple technical and business functions and maintain execution against demanding vehicle program milestones.

job.title: Senior Instructional Designer - Manufacturing Training
job.description:
Senior Instructional Designer – Manufacturing Training

Overview

Help build the training foundation for a growing manufacturing operation. As a Senior Instructional Designer – Manufacturing Training, you will design and implement a comprehensive learning ecosystem that promotes safety, quality, compliance, and workforce readiness across manufacturing teams.

This role is ideal for an experienced instructional designer who excels at translating complex technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions into clear, engaging, competency-based learning experiences. You will develop virtual, instructor-led, and on-the-job training that guides associates from foundational knowledge through hands-on qualification. Success in this role requires comfort working in an industrial environment, collaborating closely with subject matter experts, and using digital learning tools and systems to support a high-quality training program.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop structured curricula for manufacturing and logistics associates, including:
  • Virtual training
  • Instructor-led training (ILT)
  • On-the-job training (OJT)
  • Certification and qualification frameworks
  • Create engaging virtual learning modules using Articulate 360 and Rise.
  • Apply instructional design best practices, including information chunking, interactive engagement, and accessibility standards.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and technical writers to translate technical specifications, work instructions, and SOPs into practical training materials.
  • Support technical writing teams with training-related development, style guidelines, content standards, and quality expectations.
  • Develop criteria-based assessments and practical qualification checklists to verify competency and knowledge retention.
  • Define and standardize OJT processes, qualification criteria, and transitions from virtual learning to supervised practical application.
  • Support the management and optimization of the Docebo Learning Management System.
  • Independently organize and manage training development and delivery for an assigned area.
  • Maintain high standards for content quality, organization, accessibility, and LMS delivery.
  • Collaborate with SMEs, managers, technical writers, and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced, in-person manufacturing environment.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of instructional design experience, specifically in a technical, industrial, or manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and developing both virtual and live training programs.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning theory and interactive engagement strategies.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Articulate 360, including Rise and Storyline.
  • Familiarity with enterprise Learning Management Systems; experience with Docebo is required.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and AI tools.
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex technical documentation into clear, engaging, and action-oriented learning content.
  • Experience creating assessments, qualification checklists, certification programs, and competency-based learning experiences.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with SMEs, managers, technical writers, and manufacturing teams.
  • Ability to independently manage, organize, and deliver high-quality training content through an LMS.
  • Comfort working with technical machinery, digital applications, operational tools, and systems used in a modern manufacturing facility.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience developing training for autonomous vehicles, automotive production, or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Background in a highly regulated industry, such as utilities, aviation, medical devices, or pharmaceuticals.
  • Experience building or scaling a manufacturing training program.
  • Experience establishing standardized OJT processes and practical qualification frameworks.
  • Experience guiding technical writers or contributing to organizational content and style standards.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing and logistics operations, safety training, or compliance-focused learning programs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Professional certificate or master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Five to seven years of instructional design experience in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Direct experience developing training programs for manufacturing, logistics, automotive, autonomous vehicle, or other highly technical operations is strongly preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Hayward, California.
  • Engagement: Six-month position.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Ability to work effectively in an in-person factory environment and collaborate directly with manufacturing stakeholders.
  • Start date is ASAP.

job.title: Payroll Consultant
job.description:
Payroll Consultant – U.S. & Canada Payroll | Part-Time Contract

Overview

Support accurate, compliant payroll operations for a growing technology organization as a Payroll Consultant. This part-time role will manage end-to-end payroll processing for approximately 400 employees across the United States and Canada, using Rippling to process payroll, run reports, and validate results.

You will also prepare and book payroll-related journal entries, reconcile payroll activity, resolve discrepancies, and collaborate with Human Resources, Finance, Benefits, Accounting, and external payroll partners. This is an opportunity to make an immediate impact while supporting an upcoming transition to Workday Payroll. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable working independently, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of end-to-end payroll processing experience
  • Hands-on experience processing payroll for both U.S. and Canadian employees
  • Direct experience processing payroll and running reports in Rippling
  • Experience preparing and booking payroll-related journal entries
  • Strong understanding of U.S. and Canadian payroll laws, tax regulations, and compliance requirements
  • Experience with payroll reconciliations, payroll taxes, year-end processing, and audits
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and data analysis
  • Ability to review and process payroll inputs, including:
  • New hires and terminations
  • Time sheets and compensation changes
  • Bonuses, commissions, and equity-related compensation
  • Deductions, benefits, and garnishments
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and discrepancy-resolution skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to payroll accuracy
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external providers
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage competing priorities independently

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Experience with Workday Payroll
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Experience supporting a high-growth technology organization
  • Familiarity with the payroll implications of equity compensation, including RSUs, stock options, and ESPP
  • Experience optimizing payroll processes and strengthening internal controls
  • Experience supporting payroll system implementations or migrations
  • Experience developing scalable payroll processes in a rapidly growing organization

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive payroll processing experience, including responsibility for U.S. and Canadian payroll
  • Experience supporting payroll for a workforce of approximately 400 employees
  • Professional payroll certification, such as CPP, is preferred but not required
  • A specific educational background was not provided for this role

Other Requirements

  • Part-time schedule of approximately 20 hours per week
  • Initial contract duration of approximately 2 months, with potential to extend into April 2027
  • Remote work is available; candidates able to work onsite in Mountain View one day per week are preferred
  • Ability to process payroll accurately and on schedule
  • Ability to maintain complete payroll records and documentation in accordance with company policies and audit requirements
  • Ability to support payroll tax reporting, year-end activities, audits, ad hoc reporting, and special projects
  • Ability to work independently while partnering closely with Human Resources, Finance, Benefits, Accounting, and external payroll providers
  • Anticipated start date: 11/09/2026

job.title: Design Engineer
job.description:
Design Engineer, Parking Technology Solutions

Overview

Design site-specific parking and mobility technology solutions that connect real-world infrastructure with integrated access, revenue, guidance, payment, security, and analytics systems. As the technical bridge between client needs and buildable field solutions, you will translate discovery findings, product capabilities, physical site conditions, and applicable codes into accurate drawings, models, network diagrams, and installation-ready documentation.

This client- and contractor-facing role partners with Sales, Quoting, Operations, and installation teams throughout the project lifecycle—from initial discovery and technical feasibility through design acceptance, handoff, and delivery. Your work will help ensure solutions are practical, code-conscious, clearly documented, and ready to build with minimal rework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop site-specific designs for parking access and revenue control, parking guidance, payment, security, and related technology systems.
  • Produce accurate 2D layouts and 3D models showing equipment placement, lane configurations, sightlines, clearances, cable and conduit routing, and sensor coverage.
  • Perform turn-radius analysis, clearance checks, and other technical studies as required.
  • Review designs against physical and structural conditions, municipal requirements, accessibility standards, fire and life-safety considerations, and local ordinances.
  • Create basic site network diagrams for field devices such as license plate recognition cameras, security cameras, gates, barriers, and payment kiosks.
  • Apply consistent IP addressing and naming conventions while identifying potential address conflicts across typical site networks of approximately 4–15 devices.
  • Collaborate with Sales to shape solutions around client objectives and site requirements.
  • Support quoting and estimating with itemized equipment, material, and installation-scope breakdowns.
  • Lead technical discussions with clients and representatives, present proposed drawings, answer questions, and manage revisions through acceptance.
  • Present accepted designs to installation contractors and confirm scope, methodology, and sequencing before work begins.
  • Support Operations and contractors with design-related questions during project delivery.
  • Maintain complete, organized design records from discovery and site data through final client-accepted drawings.
  • Develop and maintain standardized drawing templates, material requirements, and bills of materials.
  • Contribute to related deliverables such as safety management plans, traffic and turn-radius studies, signage, and wayfinding drawings.
  • Capture lessons learned and recurring site issues to improve design standards and reduce rework.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 3–5 years of experience producing technical or engineering drawings for physical installations, such as parking, security and access control, low-voltage systems, civil/site works, or a related technical design field.
  • Ability to work independently on client-facing design decisions.
  • Proficiency with a major CAD platform; AutoCAD experience is required.
  • Ability to create and navigate 3D models using SketchUp, Revit, or a similar tool.
  • Working knowledge of civil engineering standards and site-drawing conventions, including clearances, accessibility, grading, striping, and signage.
  • Experience using Bluebeam Revu or an equivalent tool for markups, redlines, and drawing reviews.
  • Working knowledge of local network fundamentals, including:
  • IP addressing and subnetting
  • Static IP assignment
  • Basic switch and Power over Ethernet topology
  • Avoiding address conflicts
  • Diagramming self-contained site networks
  • Strong understanding of file organization, naming conventions, revision control, and project archiving.
  • Ability to interpret and reconcile client requirements, sales commitments, municipal codes, and product capabilities.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent designs across discovery, development, review, acceptance, and delivery.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365.
  • Willingness to collaborate across time zones with distributed Sales, Operations, and design teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with parking access and revenue control systems, parking guidance, license plate recognition, gate and barrier hardware, or LiDAR-based sensing systems.
  • Experience designing for multiple jurisdictions with varying local codes and requirements.
  • Familiarity with ADA/accessibility standards.
  • Experience with traffic or turn-radius analysis tools such as AutoTURN.
  • Background in structured low-voltage, access control, CCTV, or related security-system design.
  • Working knowledge of Civil 3D, Revit, or MicroStation.
  • Experience with Salesforce or quoting- and customer relationship management tools.
  • Autodesk Certified Professional/User certification or a comparable vendor credential.
  • Genuine interest in parking, mobility, physical-security, or related technology solutions.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • An associate or bachelor’s degree in drafting/CAD, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, construction-related engineering, or a similar discipline is preferred.
  • Equivalent hands-on experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Three to five or more years of relevant technical design experience is preferred, with demonstrated involvement in projects from discovery or site input through accepted, issued design.
  • Experience working directly with clients and contractors on technical drawings is strongly preferred over purely back-office drafting experience.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: United States-based position; the specific onsite, hybrid, or remote arrangement will depend on the assigned posting location.
  • Travel: Periodic domestic travel is required for client discovery meetings, design reviews, site coordination, and contractor pre-installation meetings. Travel frequency will vary based on project needs.
  • Must be comfortable presenting designs to clients and contractors and coordinating with contractors onsite.
  • A portfolio of 2D drawings and 3D models is required, demonstrating accurate dimensioning, clash-checked layouts, and designs used for actual construction or installation.
  • Portfolio materials should demonstrate end-to-end involvement in at least one project, from discovery or site input through accepted and issued design.

job.title: Jr Rev Ops Analyst
job.description:
Jr. Revenue Operations Analyst

Overview

Support a critical CRM data-quality initiative as a Jr. Revenue Operations Analyst. In this remote contract role, you will review historical HubSpot deal records, examine related customer contracts and order forms, and ensure missing or incomplete line-item information is accurately documented. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with structured data, interpreting commercial agreements, and independently completing detail-intensive projects.

Required Skills

  • 1–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Business Operations, CRM Administration, or a related analytical or operations role
  • Hands-on experience with a revenue CRM, such as HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience using Slack for communication and collaboration
  • Ability to interpret contracts, order forms, and commercial agreements
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when managing repetitive, data-intensive work
  • Ability to reconcile information across contracts and CRM records
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to escalate discrepancies and request clarification
  • Ability to work independently, proactively, and effectively in a fast-paced remote environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience with HubSpot deals, products, and line items
  • Background supporting a B2B SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with subscription pricing, recurring revenue, contract terms, and SaaS commercial agreements
  • Experience with CRM migrations, historical data backfills, data cleansing, or contract-to-CRM reconciliation
  • Experience performing data-quality reviews and documenting exceptions

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience level: 1–4+ years in a relevant Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, CRM, business operations, or analytical role
  • Preferred education: The available role information does not specify an educational requirement

Other Requirements

  • Temporary contract assignment expected to last approximately 2–3 months
  • Remote position
  • Full-time availability preferred, approximately 40 hours per week
  • Ability to review and accurately update historical CRM records
  • Ability to track completed work, unresolved exceptions, and required follow-up
  • Availability to collaborate with Revenue Operations stakeholders regarding data-entry standards and exceptions
  • No certifications are specified for this role

job.title: AI Use Case Builder (Artifacts, Apps & Visualizations)
job.description:
AI Use Case Builder — Artifacts, Apps & Visualizations

Overview

Turn ambitious ideas into remarkable, working AI experiences. We’re seeking a highly autonomous AI Use Case Builder to create interactive artifacts, web applications, data visualizations, simulations, and games powered by modern large language models and agentic workflows.

In this hands-on, 0-to-1 role, you’ll transform trending topics, complex concepts, and raw ideas into polished, technically impressive builds. You’ll own the process from ideation and rapid prototyping through engineering and deployment, using AI, modern web technologies, external APIs, real-time data, and specialized tools to create experiences that are both engaging and highly functional.

This is an engineering and builder role focused on code, interactive interfaces, and technical prototypes—not video or social media production.

What You’ll Do

  • Ideate and develop compelling AI use cases, interactive artifacts, mini-apps, simulations, data visualizations, and games.
  • Take ambiguous concepts from idea to functional, deployed experience with minimal design or project management support.
  • Use LLMs, developer tools, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, and automation to accelerate development.
  • Build responsive, engaging user experiences with dynamic visualizations, real-time data integrations, interactive controls, and lightweight game mechanics.
  • Integrate external tools, production datasets, specialized APIs, 3D and rendering engines, and other technologies that extend the capabilities of AI models.
  • Set up subscriptions and API access as needed for data, services, and production workflows.
  • Generate synthetic data when appropriate to support prototypes and demonstrations.
  • Make thoughtful technical and creative trade-offs involving performance, usability, visual impact, and engagement.
  • Rapidly prototype and deploy live builds using platforms such as Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare.
  • Independently evaluate whether a completed artifact is polished, distinctive, and compelling enough to stand out.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to build and ship interactive, functional software experiences end to end.
  • Strong proficiency with modern frontend and backend development, including:
  • TypeScript or JavaScript
  • React and/or Next.js
  • Python
  • Tailwind CSS
  • REST and/or WebSocket APIs
  • Practical experience building with modern LLM APIs and AI developer tools.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, agentic loops, multi-agent workflows, and/or retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
  • Familiarity with tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable open-source agent frameworks.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and deploy working artifacts under tight timelines.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make independent implementation decisions.
  • High agency, resourcefulness, and comfort working from ambiguous prompts or emerging concepts.
  • Ability to create polished interactive user interfaces and data-driven experiences.
  • A public portfolio is required, including 2–3 links to impressive AI-powered artifacts, deployed applications, data visualizations, games, interactive demonstrations, or open-source repositories.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience integrating 3D, rendering, CAD, or specialized creative tools and APIs.
  • Familiarity with Blender, Three.js, Unreal Engine, FreeCAD, Minecraft modding tools, or other 3D and simulation platforms.
  • Experience working with real-time data sources, digital archives, scientific datasets, production APIs, or other specialized data.
  • Experience generating and working with synthetic datasets.
  • Background building games, simulations, interactive maps, visual storytelling experiences, or other highly visual applications.
  • Experience rapidly deploying prototypes through Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to identify emerging topics and translate them into technically ambitious, engaging builds.
  • Experience developing under severe time constraints while maintaining a high standard of polish and performance.

Preferred Education and Experience

A formal degree is not specified for this role. Demonstrated capability through shipped work and a strong portfolio is highly valued.

Preferred candidates will have substantial hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, interactive prototypes, web artifacts, visualizations, or games. Experience taking projects from concept through live deployment independently is strongly preferred. Equivalent practical experience, technical experimentation, and exceptional proof of work may substitute for formal education.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Remote, part-time.
  • Engagement: Three-month contract with potential to extend.
  • Candidates must provide 2–3 public links to completed or active projects.
  • Portfolio submissions should demonstrate end-to-end ownership, technical depth, interactivity, and visual or functional quality.
  • Candidates should be able to describe the LLMs, frameworks, APIs, and developer tools they use, as well as how they rapidly prototype and deploy AI-powered artifacts.
  • No travel or certifications are specified for this role.

job.title: Payroll Analyst
job.description:
Payroll Analyst

Overview

Join a collaborative payroll team as a Payroll Analyst responsible for processing accurate, timely payroll for approximately 1,000 employees across multiple states. This role serves as the primary U.S. payroll processor, managing biweekly, semi-monthly, and off-cycle payrolls for both hourly and salaried employees.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented payroll professional who takes ownership, works confidently under deadlines, and enjoys balancing payroll processing, auditing, compliance, reconciliations, and employee support. This is a strong opportunity to contribute immediately while expanding your exposure to global payroll operations.

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of payroll processing experience
  • Experience supporting multi-state and multi-location payrolls
  • Experience processing payroll for both hourly and salaried employees
  • Ability to process biweekly, semi-monthly, and off-cycle payrolls
  • Hands-on experience with ADP Workforce Now
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including:
  • VLOOKUPs
  • PivotTables
  • Formula functions
  • Knowledge of payroll taxes, garnishments, and payroll compliance requirements
  • Experience auditing payroll data and performing reconciliations
  • Ability to investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies
  • Strong system navigation, reporting, and data validation skills
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy
  • Strong communication and employee support skills
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Proactive approach to identifying and communicating potential issues

Responsibilities

  • Process biweekly, semi-monthly, and off-cycle payrolls
  • Audit employee changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, and payroll corrections
  • Create payroll batches and validate payroll calculations and outputs
  • Reconcile payroll data and research discrepancies
  • Respond to employee payroll questions and resolve issues promptly
  • Manage payroll taxes, garnishments, compliance requirements, and reporting
  • Assist with year-end payroll activities, audits, W-2 preparation, and reconciliation
  • Partner with Human Resources on new-hire support and payroll-related onboarding activities
  • Collaborate with Accounting on payroll reconciliations and reporting
  • Support international payroll processes and administration as opportunities arise
  • Ensure all payroll deadlines are met accurately and efficiently

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting global payroll operations
  • International tax and compliance experience
  • Experience with Vistra OsC
  • ADP Celergo experience
  • Experience with new-hire orientation or onboarding
  • Year-end payroll processing experience
  • W-2 preparation and reconciliation experience

job.title: SEC Consultant
job.description:
SEC Reporting Consultant

Overview

Support the accurate and timely preparation of critical SEC filings in a fully remote, long-term consulting engagement with recurring quarterly work. The SEC Reporting Consultant will play a hands-on role in preparing annual Form 10-K and quarterly Form 10-Q filings for a publicly traded company, providing continuity and specialized expertise across recurring reporting cycles.

This opportunity is well suited for a manager-level SEC reporting professional who can independently manage filing preparation, document roll-forwards, financial statement tie-outs, disclosure updates, and deadline-driven deliverables. The engagement is expected to span approximately two to three weeks per quarter, beginning in January 2027 and aligning with annual and quarterly SEC filing deadlines.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience preparing SEC filings for publicly traded companies, including Form 10-K and Form 10-Q.
  • Strong understanding of SEC reporting requirements, financial statement presentation, and disclosure practices.
  • Ability to independently manage:
  • Prior-period document roll-forwards
  • Financial statement and footnote updates
  • Disclosure reviews and updates
  • Financial statement tie-outs
  • Tick-and-tie procedures
  • Redline generation and review
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to work efficiently and independently under defined SEC reporting deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with the Controller and address reporting comments, revisions, and outstanding deliverables.
  • Availability for recurring engagements of approximately two to three weeks per quarter.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with DFIN reporting software.
  • Prior consulting, contract, or project-based SEC reporting experience.
  • Experience supporting both annual and quarterly reporting cycles.
  • Experience contributing to disclosure updates, including revenue-related disclosures.
  • Experience working within streamlined public-company reporting processes.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Manager-level experience in SEC reporting, financial reporting, or a closely related function.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing SEC filings for publicly traded companies.
  • CPA designation is a plus but not required.
  • Candidates from any industry background will be considered; practical, hands-on public-company SEC reporting experience is the primary qualification.
  • A specific degree requirement has not been provided.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Start date: January 2027.
  • Engagement schedule: Approximately two to three weeks per quarter, aligned with SEC filing deadlines.
  • Must be available to support the annual Form 10-K process and quarterly Form 10-Q reporting cycles.
  • Must be comfortable working independently while coordinating closely with the Controller.
  • Big Four experience is not required; direct SEC reporting expertise is the priority.

job.title: Web Developer
job.description:

In this junior-to-mid-level role, you’ll manage day-to-day web content updates, assemble pages using established components and building blocks, and support routine publishing across multiple international sites.

This opportunity is well suited to a proactive, detail-oriented professional who communicates clearly, manages work independently, and is comfortable working with existing web structures. This is a content authoring and web design role—not a full-stack software engineering position—so success will come from confidently using established templates, components, and publishing processes rather than developing applications from scratch.

Required Skills

  • Experience with web content updates, page assembly, web design, or digital publishing
  • Ability to work with existing web components, templates, and building blocks
  • Basic familiarity with reading and reusing code
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluent English proficiency
  • Excellent organization, self-management, and attention to detail
  • Proactive approach to identifying and completing work independently
  • Ability to manage routine publishing activities accurately across multiple global websites
  • Willingness to learn established processes, accept feedback, and adapt to changing priorities

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with content management systems or digital publishing platforms
  • Experience working with global or distributed web teams
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or related web technologies
  • Experience assembling pages from pre-existing components rather than developing software from scratch
  • Familiarity with component-based content management and publishing workflows

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Junior-to-mid-level experience in web content, web design, digital publishing, or a related area
  • Degree, certificate, or formal training in web design, digital media, communications, or a related field

Other Requirements

job.title: HubSpot Administrator
job.description:
HubSpot Administrator

Overview

Join a Revenue Operations team as the hands-on owner of the HubSpot environment that powers Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. In this remote, contract-to-hire opportunity, you’ll manage CRM configuration, workflow automation, integrations, user permissions, and data quality while helping teams operate more efficiently and confidently.

You’ll troubleshoot complex system issues, translate business needs into scalable solutions, maintain reliable data flows across the go-to-market technology stack, and contribute to ongoing systems strategy. This role is ideal for a practical systems professional who enjoys hands-on administration, clear documentation, cross-functional partnership, and solving ambiguous problems in a fast-moving environment.

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on HubSpot administration experience, including direct ownership of CRM configuration and maintenance.
  • Advanced proficiency with CRM administration, including:
  • User permissions
  • Custom objects
  • Workflow automation
  • Field configuration and taxonomy
  • Data quality management
  • Experience connecting marketing automation, CRM, revenue intelligence, and sales engagement platforms.
  • Ability to maintain reliable data flows across interconnected go-to-market systems.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, deduplication, data standards, and quality controls.
  • Ability to translate business goals and requirements into documented, scalable technical configurations.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate data discrepancies, develop hypotheses, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to triage incoming requests, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills when partnering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation skills in a remote-first environment.
  • Experience in a Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, or related systems role.
  • Ability to support teams across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Comfort working independently, managing shifting priorities, and supporting a broad range of systems requests.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • HubSpot Administrator or Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Experience with platforms such as 6sense, Gong, Outreach, or Gainsight.
  • Familiarity with SQL or data warehouse querying, including Snowflake or BigQuery, for ad hoc analysis.
  • Experience with AI-assisted workflow automation or prompt-based tooling in a go-to-market environment.
  • Exposure to multi-product or multi-segment go-to-market motions.
  • Experience evaluating go-to-market technology and assessing integration, adoption, and maintenance requirements.
  • Background supporting a B2B SaaS organization.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, CRM administration, or a related systems function.
  • At least 3 years of direct HubSpot administration experience.
  • Direct ownership of CRM administration responsibilities, rather than experience limited to using CRM platforms as an end user.
  • The provided job information does not specify a required or preferred degree.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Contract or contract-to-hire opportunity.
  • Strong written communication and proactive documentation are essential.
  • Candidates should be comfortable diagnosing ambiguous issues, managing incoming requests, and delivering scalable solutions.
  • No travel requirements were specified.

job.title: Sr. Accounting Manager
job.description:
Sr. Accounting Manager

Overview

A growing, R&D-focused organization is seeking a hands-on Sr. Accounting Manager to provide interim support across core accounting operations. This individual will play a key role in executing the monthly close, maintaining accurate general ledger activity, and managing fixed asset, international, revenue, lease, and accounts receivable accounting processes.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical accounting expertise, advanced proficiency with Oracle Fusion Cloud, and the ability to independently manage detailed accounting responsibilities within a structured, deadline-driven environment. This is an individual contributor role that requires sound judgment, meticulous documentation, and effective cross-functional collaboration.

Required Skills

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including experience at the Senior Accountant or Accounting Manager level
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, including:
  • Fixed asset accounting
  • Capitalization and construction-in-progress accounting
  • Depreciation
  • ASC 842 lease accounting
  • Proven experience managing monthly close activities, journal entries, account reconciliations, and general ledger reporting
  • Hands-on experience with fixed asset accounting, including additions, adjustments, transfers, disposals, reinstatements, depreciation, and subledger-to-general-ledger reconciliations
  • Working knowledge of foreign currency translation, international accounting, multi-entity accounting, and consolidation principles
  • Experience with revenue recognition and accruals
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight monthly close deadlines, particularly during the period from Day -3 through Day 7
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation
  • Ability to appropriately escalate accounting judgments and collaborate with accounting leadership
  • Comfort working in a structured, control-conscious accounting environment
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • CPA or equivalent qualification
  • Experience in biotechnology, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or another R&D-intensive industry
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud General Ledger, Fixed Assets, and Subledger Accounting
  • Experience with Oracle Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
  • Familiarity with ASC 606 revenue recognition, particularly collaboration or partnership arrangements
  • Experience with intercompany eliminations and foreign subsidiaries
  • Experience supporting SOX compliance, audit readiness, or external audits
  • Experience with Oracle ADI
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted accounting workflows and tools used for reconciliations and elimination entries
  • Experience using Google Workspace, Slack, and AI-assisted accounting tools

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Experience independently owning accounting processes within a complex, multi-entity, or R&D-focused environment
  • CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred

Key Responsibilities

Financial Close and Reporting

  • Review Oracle journals to confirm all entries have been posted
  • Review profit and loss cost-center reports and account-combination listings
  • Update FP&A workbooks to support monthly flux analysis
  • Pull trial balances and prepare supporting account reconciliations
  • Run monthly journal entry listings and update capital expenditure schedules for budget-versus-actual reporting
  • Review annual 1099 filings
  • Prepare required filings, including annual business surveys, quarterly financial reports, R&D census reports, and property tax filings

Revenue Recognition and Accruals

  • Prepare monthly collaboration revenue journal entries
  • Review time inputs with program teams and reconcile deferred revenue
  • Calculate revenue recognition in accordance with documented procedures
  • Prepare and maintain partnership and milestone accruals
  • Update accrual calculations when milestones are achieved or participants leave
  • Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for management review
  • Coordinate with accounting leadership on headcount budget changes, revenue recognition judgments, and other items requiring review

International Accounting

  • Upload monthly foreign exchange rates into Oracle
  • Review monthly reporting packages from international accounting teams
  • Review and upload international entity net activity and trial balances
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliation summaries for international entities
  • Execute foreign currency translation processes in Oracle
  • Prepare monthly intercompany elimination journal entries and supporting reports

Lease Accounting

  • Prepare monthly lease accounting journal entries under ASC 842
  • Maintain lease account reconciliations and supporting rollforward schedules

Expense Review and Reclassification

  • Perform pre- and post-accounts payable close reviews of designated expense accounts
  • Review prepaid transactions exceeding $10,000 and fixed asset-related transactions exceeding $5,000 for potential reclassification
  • Draft reclassification journal entries for management review
  • Identify potential new accruals based on ending prepaid balances

Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare and distribute customer invoices as needed
  • Post customer receipts and execute Oracle Create Accounting processes
  • Investigate and resolve accounts receivable subledger exceptions

Fixed Asset Accounting

  • Own the monthly fixed asset accounting cycle in Oracle Fusion Cloud
  • Process additions, adjustments, transfers, disposals, and reinstatements
  • Prepare and process Mass Additions, calculate depreciation, and execute Create Accounting
  • Reconcile the fixed asset subledger to the general ledger
  • Maintain fixed asset clearing schedules and in-service dates
  • Coordinate with Facilities, Lab Operations, Research Operations, Automation, and IT
  • Review leasehold improvement additions for appropriate construction-in-progress coding and accrual requirements
  • Maintain supporting documentation, fixed asset schedules, reconciliations, and rollforwards
  • Support year-end fixed asset cutoff reviews
  • Review inactive or on-hold asset lines in Oracle and test proposed deletions for general ledger impact before processing

Other Requirements

  • Interim engagement of approximately 3 months, with potential for extension
  • 40-hour workweek, with the heaviest workload occurring during monthly close
  • Hybrid schedule: 3 days per week onsite in South San Francisco, generally Tuesday, Thursday, and one flexible weekday
  • Must be comfortable working as an individual contributor and independently executing detailed accounting processes
  • Must be proficient with Oracle Fusion Cloud and able to quickly navigate general ledger, fixed assets, and subledger accounting functions
  • Must maintain confidentiality, accurate records, and thorough supporting documentation throughout all accounting activities

job.title: SAP Data Entry Analyst
job.description:
SAP Data Entry Analyst

Overview

Support the accuracy and efficiency of logistics operations as an SAP Data Entry Analyst in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. This role is responsible for maintaining reliable inventory data, processing goods receipts, coordinating stock transfers, resolving discrepancies, and helping ensure parts are available to support production and service requirements.

You’ll serve as a key liaison between Logistics Inventory Planning, Warehouse Operations, Suppliers, Procurement, and Material Planning. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing time-sensitive data and operational requests across multiple teams and enterprise systems.

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in data entry, logistics support, inventory operations, or a related field
  • Proven ability to enter data quickly, accurately, and consistently
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies
  • Experience processing goods receipts and matching purchase orders and purchase order lines
  • Ability to coordinate inventory movements and stock transfer orders between locations
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with internal and external partners
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, cross-functional operational environment
  • Experience with SAP, Coupa, Ariba, or similar enterprise systems
  • Ability to review shipping documents and verify that required paperwork is complete and accurate
  • Ability to follow established testing allocations, operational procedures, and data-entry guidelines

Nice to Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience with SAP
  • Experience in automotive manufacturing or another complex production environment
  • Background in inventory management or materials planning
  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives involving data accuracy, receiving processes, or system integration
  • Familiarity with Jira requests or similar workflow-management tools

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in data entry, logistics support, inventory operations, materials planning, or a related operational function

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Hayward, CA
  • Travel of up to 10% may be required, including international travel
  • W2 employment only
  • Ability to support a 6-month assignment with an ASAP start date

job.title: Sr Accountant
job.description:
Sr Accountant

Overview

Join a dynamic finance team as a Sr Accountant supporting a complex, multi-entity organization with a strong focus on technical accounting, process improvement, and operational excellence. This remote opportunity is ideal for an accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership of month-end and quarter-end close activities, analyzing financial results, and improving processes through technology and automation.

In this role, you will work closely with Finance, FP&A, Payroll, Benefits, and Accounts Receivable teams to ensure accurate reporting, strengthen internal controls, and resolve operational accounting challenges. You will also have the opportunity to apply AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to streamline accounting workflows and accelerate the close process.

Required Skills

  • 4+ years of accounting experience, including strong general ledger and month-end close experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, and financial reporting
  • Demonstrated experience with:
  • Month-end and quarter-end close
  • Journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations
  • OPEX accruals and IBNR
  • Capitalized commissions
  • Incurred but not billed revenue
  • Flux and variance analysis
  • Experience working in a multi-entity environment, including intercompany transactions
  • Proficiency with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system; NetSuite experience is required
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, and analysis of large datasets
  • Ability to identify, explain, and communicate material financial movements to finance leadership and non-accounting stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated ownership, integrity, self-motivation, and ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Ability to identify and implement accounting process improvements and internal controls

  • Experience with foreign currency transactions
  • Familiarity with technical accounting matters, including:
  • Leases under ASC 842
  • Internal-use software under ASC 350-40

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar technology to automate accounting tasks and improve workflows
  • Experience supporting external audits and owning prepared-by-client requests
  • Big Four public accounting experience combined with industry accounting experience
  • Experience with revenue accounting and related contract analysis

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Four or more years of progressive accounting experience
  • Active CA/CPA certification or candidacy preferred
  • Experience supporting medium-sized public or private companies preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Duration: Approximately 1–3 months, with potential for conversion for the right candidate
  • Ability to support a fast-paced finance environment and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to document existing and newly developed accounting processes
  • Availability to support month-end and quarter-end close deadlines
  • Willingness to contribute to special projects and other Finance initiatives as needed

job.title: Revenue Accountant
job.description:
Revenue Accountant | Contract | Hybrid in NYC

Overview

Join a growing finance team as a Revenue Accountant and play a key role in preparing for an upcoming audit. This short-term contract opportunity is ideal for an accounting professional with experience reviewing client contracts, applying revenue recognition guidance, and supporting month-end close and audit activities. You will evaluate contract terms, complete revenue recognition templates, analyze revenue-related accounts, and collaborate with internal finance partners, clients, and external auditors to help ensure accurate and well-supported financial reporting.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably with exposure to revenue accounting
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and ASC 606 revenue recognition guidance
  • Experience reviewing contracts and determining appropriate revenue recognition treatment
  • Previous internal or external audit support experience
  • Ability to analyze accrued revenue, deferred revenue, and other revenue-related balance sheet accounts
  • Experience with reconciliations, variance analysis, accruals, and month-end close activities
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve outstanding accounting items

  • Familiarity with IFRS 15 revenue recognition guidance

job.title: FP&A / Adaptive Consultant
job.description:
FP&A / Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant

Overview

Join a finance transformation initiative focused on improving planning, reporting, and automation through Workday Adaptive Planning. This hands-on consultant will partner with FP&A and Accounting to modernize existing processes, strengthen model structure, reduce manual data preparation, and build repeatable reporting workflows.

The ideal candidate combines strong FP&A expertise with the ability to configure and optimize Adaptive Planning—not simply use it as an end user. You will translate finance requirements into practical solutions, develop scalable templates and reporting processes, and document workflows for long-term ownership by the permanent FP&A team.

This is a fully remote, three-month contract engagement with potential for extension. Candidates who can work from a San Francisco office on Thursdays for face-to-face FP&A meetings are preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess existing FP&A workflows in Workday Adaptive Planning and identify opportunities to improve model hygiene, automation, and reporting.
  • Configure Adaptive input templates, data mappings, custom accounts, and processes.
  • Build recurring fixed- and variable-cost reporting by business unit and legal entity.
  • Develop standardized Excel or Google Sheets templates for accrual calculations, software capitalization, variable costs, and annual planning data.
  • Establish repeatable data-loading, validation, and reconciliation procedures using Google Sheets and financial system data.
  • Leverage the Workday for Google Sheets extension’s write-back capabilities where appropriate.
  • Create reports showing monthly cost trends, prior-period comparisons, and information needed for forecasting.
  • Automate headcount analysis and other priority FP&A processes.
  • Support dashboard development and improve visibility into financial performance.
  • Partner effectively with FP&A, Accounting, and management stakeholders.
  • Document completed workflows and train the permanent FP&A team member to maintain and enhance them.
  • Deliver foundational data preparation, mapping, and automation within a short-term engagement.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring and building solutions in Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Experience independently delivering FP&A systems improvements, planning models, or reporting automation.
  • Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, expense accruals, and fixed-versus-variable cost analysis.
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including structured templates and repeatable data-preparation processes.
  • Experience mapping, validating, and reconciling financial data across multiple systems.
  • Ability to translate finance and business requirements into practical, maintainable solutions.
  • Strong FP&A or finance background with the ability to apply Adaptive Planning in a business context.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work and deliver results during a short-term consulting engagement.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working with NetSuite financial data.
  • Experience automating compensation-related expense and headcount reporting.
  • Experience building financial dashboards and management reporting.
  • Background supporting investor requests or financial due diligence.
  • Experience with Adaptive Planning implementations, system optimizations, customizations, or significant model enhancements.
  • Experience developing processes that can be transitioned effectively to permanent finance team members.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Significant professional experience in FP&A, financial planning, accounting, or a related finance function.
  • Experience serving as an FP&A systems or Adaptive Planning consultant.
  • Specific educational requirements have not been provided; relevant finance, accounting, business, or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote position.
  • Preference for candidates who can work from a San Francisco office on Thursdays for in-person FP&A team collaboration.
  • Three-month contract engagement with potential for extension.
  • Company-issued equipment is preferred because the role may involve personally identifiable information; a virtual desktop environment may be available if needed.
  • This is a finance-focused FP&A role requiring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, rather than a general technology or systems administration position.

job.title: Assistant Controller
job.description:
Assistant Controller – Hybrid (SF / CO / WI)

We are partnering with a fast-scaling, AI-driven neo-insurer that is evolving commercial P&C insurance for brokers and small business owners. By combining industry expertise with state-of-the-art technology, automated workflows, and modern processes, the team is modernizing a traditional industry from the ground up.

They are seeking a hands-on, tech-forward Assistant Controller to take full ownership of accounting operations, the monthly close, and financial controls across five consolidated entities.

The Opportunity:


  • Own the Close: Lead the consolidated monthly, quarterly, and annual close across entities under both US GAAP and statutory accounting requirements.

  • Statutory & GAAP Reporting: Deliver consolidated GAAP financial statements, annual and quarterly NAIC statements, state insurance filings, and premium tax filings.

  • Audit & Compliance Readiness: Serve as the primary liaison to external auditors, driving PBC processes, establishing robust balance sheet integrity, and authoring technical accounting memos.

  • AI & Automation Integration: Partner with Engineering and Data Science to optimize NetSuite architecture and data pipelines, utilizing modern tools (including Claude) to automate manual workflows and eliminate recurring friction.

  • Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and develop a growing accounting team, establishing scalable processes and controls.

What You Bring:


  • 8+ years of accounting experience within insurance, financial services, or public accounting serving those clients (P&C carrier, MGA/MGU, reinsurance, or program business experience strongly preferred).

  • 3+ years of direct management experience scaling accounting professionals.

  • Demonstrated ownership of multi-entity month-end closes, consolidations, and external audit management.

  • Strong command of US GAAP and statutory accounting principles.

  • Hands-on experience with modern ERPs (NetSuite strongly preferred).

  • A tech-forward mindset with a proven ability to leverage AI tools and automation to optimize workflows.

  • CPA license (or active progress) and Big 4/national firm foundation preferred.

Location & Logistics:


  • Format: Hybrid (minimum 3 days/week onsite).

  • Locations: San Francisco, CA (strongly preferred); Denver, CO; or Madison, WI.

  • Compensation: $150,000 – $190,000 base + discretionary bonus and equity.

If you are a strategic, tech-savvy accounting leader looking to make a massive impact in a high-growth, venture-backed insurtech environment, let's connect! Reach out directly or apply below.

job.title: Payroll Consultant UKG
job.description:
Payroll Consultant – UKG

Overview

A leading transit organization is seeking a senior-level Payroll Consultant with deep UKG expertise to manage complex, multi-state payroll operations supporting approximately 5,000 employees. This hands-on consulting role will own end-to-end payroll processing across biweekly and semi-monthly cycles while ensuring accurate administration across multiple union agreements and Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).

  • Experience managing payroll governed by multiple Collective Bargaining Agreements
  • Strong, hands-on experience with UKG payroll systems
  • Experience processing multi-state payroll, including California and Massachusetts
  • Knowledge of biweekly and semi-monthly payroll processing
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including payroll analysis and reconciliations
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite
  • Understanding of payroll compliance, deductions, corrections, and reporting
  • Ability to interpret and apply complex union contract requirements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage competing payroll deadlines

  • Payroll experience within the transit industry
  • Experience supporting high-volume payrolls across multiple union agreements

job.title: Senior HR Manager (part time)
job.description:
Senior HR Manager (Part-Time, Contract-to-Hire)

Overview

Join a growing biotechnology organization as a hands-on Senior HR Manager and trusted advisor to leadership. This high-impact role is ideal for an experienced HR professional who can confidently manage complex employee relations, guide leaders through sensitive workplace matters, and build practical HR infrastructure in a dynamic, evolving environment.

You will take ownership of key HR initiatives, including performance management, compliance, employee investigations, manager coaching, policy development, and process improvement. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by establishing scalable HR practices while partnering closely with leadership on organizational and workforce needs.

The position is expected to begin at 20–30 hours per week, with flexibility regarding workdays and scheduling. As the organization continues to grow, the role may have the potential to expand.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive, hands-on Human Resources experience
  • Approximately five years of experience at the HR Manager level or above
  • Demonstrated expertise managing complex employee relations matters, including:

  • Disciplinary actions
  • Workplace investigations
  • Employee complaints
  • Conflict resolution
  • Performance-related issues
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws, including FMLA, ADA, FLSA, wage and hour requirements, and anti-discrimination regulations
  • Experience developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, handbooks, templates, and workflows
  • Proven ability to build or significantly improve HR processes in a startup, high-growth, entrepreneurial, or similarly evolving environment
  • Experience creating structured performance management programs, including performance reviews, goal setting, and performance improvement plans
  • Strong manager coaching skills, particularly related to performance, accountability, communication, and conflict resolution
  • Ability to advise senior leadership on sensitive employee matters, organizational challenges, and employment-related risks
  • Sound judgment, discretion, business acumen, and strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and confidently manage confidential matters
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and limited existing structure

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in the biotechnology industry

  • Experience working in a startup or rapidly scaling organization
  • Experience supporting organizational change, restructuring, or workforce planning

Preferred Education and Experience

A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field is preferred. Candidates should have at least 10 years of progressive HR experience, including substantial responsibility for employee relations, compliance, performance management, and HR process development.

Other Requirements
