  • Primary location: Burlington, Massachusetts
  • Ability to work onsite approximately 20–30 hours per week with flexibility regarding days and schedule
  • Ability to travel to Boston as needed
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity
  • Must be comfortable handling sensitive, confidential employee and organizational matters
  • Must be able to operate effectively in a hands-on role with evolving responsibilities and priorities

job.title: Validation Engineer
job.description:
Validation Engineer – Embedded, HMI, OTA & Cloud

Overview

Join a hands-on Validation Engineering team responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and functionality of advanced automotive software platforms. As a Validation Engineer, you will write test automation code, debug integration issues, and validate connected vehicle technologies across embedded systems, Android-based human-machine interfaces, and cloud-to-vehicle platforms.

This code-centric opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex system-level problems and building robust, repeatable automation. Candidates may specialize in embedded validation, HMI testing, or over-the-air and cloud validation.

Required Skills

  • 2–6 years of experience in software testing, test development, validation engineering, or a related field
  • Strong hands-on programming or scripting experience with one or more of the following:
  • Python
  • C
  • JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Comfort working in Linux environments, including system navigation, configuration, and testing
  • Experience developing automated tests and troubleshooting software or system integration issues
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work hands-on with technical systems, testing tools, and automation frameworks

Embedded Validation

  • Experience writing test scripts in C and Python
  • Knowledge of embedded software, AUTOSAR, or base software (BSW)
  • Experience testing hardware-software interfaces
  • Exposure to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments
  • Experience with driver automation or low-level firmware integration testing

HMI Validation

  • Experience testing Android-based applications or platforms
  • Background validating user workflows, UI interactions, or vehicle display systems
  • Python scripting experience
  • Ability to convert manual test scenarios into automated test suites
  • Experience identifying and debugging UI/UX integration and system-level performance defects

OTA and Cloud Validation

  • Experience validating web applications, backend services, or cloud-to-device workflows
  • Proficiency with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or comparable UI automation tools
  • Experience performing REST API testing
  • Ability to trace and validate data flow across front-end interfaces, backend services, and vehicle platforms

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Buildkite
  • Exposure to Docker or Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of automotive communication protocols, including CAN, Ethernet, or LIN
  • Understanding of connected vehicle architectures
  • Experience with over-the-air updates, campaign management, device registration, or fleet orchestration

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred
  • 2–6 years of professional experience in validation engineering, software testing, embedded systems, HMI automation, cloud validation, or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to write production-quality test automation and troubleshoot complex technical issues

Other Requirements

  • Initial 3–6-month contract with potential for extension or direct-hire conversion based on business needs and performance
  • Candidates must have valid work authorization
  • This is a hands-on, code-centric role requiring active participation in test development, automation, debugging, and system validation
  • Work arrangement is not specified in the provided job details; remote or onsite status will be confirmed separately

job.title: Cost Accountant
job.description:
Cost Accountant II

Overview

Join a growing manufacturing organization as a Cost Accountant II and play a vital role in maintaining accurate inventory valuations, strengthening cost controls, and supporting informed financial decision-making. This contract-to-hire opportunity is ideal for an accounting professional with cost accounting experience who is ready to contribute to standard costing, inventory analysis, manufacturing variance review, month-end close, and financial reporting.

In this role, you will collaborate with Procurement, Accounting, and operational teams to ensure the accuracy and integrity of inventory and production data while supporting continuous improvement across accounting processes.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • Two to three years of cost accounting experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Experience with standard costing, inventory accounting, and manufacturing variance analysis
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret inventory, production, labor, and overhead data
  • Experience preparing journal entries and performing account and inventory reconciliations
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Windows-based software
  • Ability to review data for accuracy, identify discrepancies, and communicate findings clearly
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Procurement, Accounting, and operational teams

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Oracle, NetSuite, SAP, or another enterprise resource planning system
  • Familiarity with JSOX or similar internal control procedures
  • Experience reviewing work-in-process inventory and manufacturing job closures
  • Knowledge of cycle count programs and inventory control processes
  • Experience analyzing gross margins, absorption, and production variances
  • General ledger accounting experience
  • Interest in process improvement and enhancing accounting procedures

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline
  • Two to three years of relevant cost accounting experience, preferably in a standard-cost manufacturing environment
  • Experience supporting month-end close, inventory reporting, and financial reconciliations

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of inventory and production data
  • Assist with monthly standard cost updates in partnership with Procurement
  • Review last-receipt data and support cost-related discussions with Procurement
  • Monitor inventory movement and provide analysis for management review
  • Assist with the annual review of labor and overhead rates
  • Analyze over- and under-absorption to support accurate inventory valuation
  • Review work-in-process inventory and manufacturing jobs for completeness and timely closure
  • Analyze manufacturing variances, including material usage and labor variances
  • Prepare month-end cost accounting journal entries
  • Reconcile perpetual inventory records to the General Ledger
  • Perform inventory reconciliations and prepare inventory-related reports
  • Prepare monthly gross margin reports and investigate low or negative margins
  • Support periodic cycle counts and evaluate the adequacy of cycle count processes
  • Assist with JSOX internal controls
  • Support Senior Accountants with journal entries, reconciliations, and other accounting activities

Other Requirements

  • Full-time, onsite position in Bedford, NH; remote work is not available
  • Standard hours are 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with some flexibility in the daily schedule
  • Must be able to participate in periodic cycle counts and collaborate with onsite teams
  • Business-casual work environment
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity

job.title: Procurement Manager
job.description:
Procurement Manager — Remote Contract Opportunity

Overview

Lead essential procurement operations in a fast-paced, complex environment as a Procurement Manager supporting purchasing requests from intake through resolution. This fully remote contract role is ideal for a confident procurement professional who can manage competing priorities, troubleshoot purchasing system issues, guide business users, and collaborate across Procurement, Finance, Legal, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

You will help keep purchasing workflows moving by reviewing requests, resolving exceptions, coordinating supplier onboarding, monitoring operational queues, and identifying opportunities to improve processes and documentation. The engagement is expected to last 6–8 months, with potential for extension.

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated experience managing procurement or purchasing operations in a complex, fast-paced environment
  • Required experience with Coupa
  • Proven ability to manage and triage purchasing requests through a procure-to-pay process or help desk
  • Experience supporting requisition and purchase order creation, updates, and issue resolution
  • Ability to review requests for completeness, coding, approvals, documentation, and purchasing requirements
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the confidence to communicate effectively and push back when necessary
  • Experience troubleshooting workflow and transaction issues in Coupa
  • Ability to partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, business stakeholders, and suppliers to resolve exceptions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to monitor open requests, aging, and operational queues
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to business users on purchasing processes and systems
  • Comfort working independently in a fast-paced, complex, and sometimes ambiguous environment

Nice to Have Skills

  • SAP experience is highly preferred
  • Experience working for a public company
  • Background supporting procurement operations within a large, complex organization
  • Experience coordinating supplier onboarding and master data requests
  • Experience maintaining process documentation
  • Exposure to continuous improvement initiatives within procurement or procure-to-pay operations

Preferred Education and Experience

Specific educational requirements and minimum years of experience were not provided. Candidates with relevant procurement operations experience, strong Coupa expertise, and experience supporting purchasing workflows in a large or complex organization are preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote
  • Preferred availability during Central or Eastern Time Zone working hours to align with the majority of the team; Pacific Time Zone candidates may also be considered
  • Contract duration is expected to be 6–8 months, with potential for extension
  • Coupa experience is required
  • SAP experience is highly preferred

job.title: Linux Application Engineer
job.description:
Join Our Innovative Team as a Linux Application Engineer

Are you passionate about building high-performance embedded Linux applications that power the future of mobility? We are seeking an experienced Linux Application Engineer to lead pivotal software initiatives within a cutting-edge vehicle platform. This role offers the opportunity to influence the next generation of automotive technology, working on complex integration, optimization, and development projects that directly impact vehicle performance and safety.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain embedded Linux applications and services for next-gen vehicle platforms
  • Drive the architecture of robust, scalable, and secure software solutions
  • Collaborate across cross-functional teams to resolve complex integration challenges
  • Optimize system performance involving CPU, GPU, memory, and I/O components
  • Troubleshoot native crashes, system failures, and resource contention issues
  • Implement diagnostics, logging, and health monitoring frameworks
  • Support software bring-up, system integration, and deployment on new hardware architectures
  • Establish and promote best practices in software development, testing, and security

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 8+ years of professional engineering experience
  • Expertise in C++ and Python, with hands-on experience developing Linux applications
  • Proven background in embedded Linux environments, multithreading, IPC, networking, and memory management
  • Skilled in debugging native crashes and complex multi-component systems
  • Familiarity with performance profiling tools such as perf, GDB, Valgrind
  • Strong understanding of system performance metrics, security models, and software packaging
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and system diagnostics
  • Excellent collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Automotive industry experience or familiarity with in-vehicle infotainment systems
  • Experience with hypervisor-based or multi-OS architectures
  • Knowledge of graphics libraries like Vulkan, OpenGL, or GPU-accelerated development
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise telemetry or system observability frameworks
  • Experience bringing Linux applications up on new hardware platforms

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline
  • 8+ years of dedicated engineering work, preferably in embedded Linux environments within automotive or high-performance systems

Additional Requirements:

  • Location: Hybrid in Foster City, CA (at least 3 days per week onsite)
  • Must be able to work W2; this role does not support C2C arrangements
  • Ability to participate in cross-disciplinary collaboration and resolve complex integration issues
  • This role does not require travel but demands a proactive, hands-on approach to software development and troubleshooting

job.title: Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician
job.description:
Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician

Overview

Build and validate the low-voltage electrical systems powering the next generation of autonomous vehicles, advanced test platforms, and prototype equipment. As a Low Voltage Wire Harness Technician, you will fabricate, install, test, and troubleshoot 12V/24V wire harnesses connecting computing systems, sensors, drive-by-wire interfaces, data networks, and power distribution components.

This hands-on, lab-based role combines precision bench fabrication with installation and validation on prototype vehicles and test benches. You will collaborate closely with design engineers to identify physical build issues, support engineering changes, maintain accurate as-built documentation, and improve the reliability of prototype fleets and test systems. High-voltage electrical work is strictly outside the scope of this position.

Required Skills

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience fabricating, installing, and troubleshooting low-voltage wire harnesses.
  • Experience in automotive, aerospace, robotics, drone, industrial, or comparable environments.
  • Ability to cut, strip, crimp, splice, shield, sleeve, label, and terminate wire harnesses.
  • Hands-on experience with automotive connectors and terminals, including:
  • Molex
  • TE Connectivity
  • Deutsch
  • Amphenol
  • Proficiency using crimp tools, pull testers, digital multimeters, harness testers, and basic CAN tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics, harness drawings, pinout tables, and bills of materials.
  • Strong knowledge of 12V/24V electrical systems, including:
  • Wire gauge selection
  • Circuit protection and fusing
  • Grounding
  • Strain relief
  • Harness routing and clearance requirements
  • Familiarity with automotive data interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, and USB.
  • Experience performing continuity, isolation, pull-force, and functional testing.
  • Ability to diagnose opens, shorts, voltage drops, bad grounds, intermittent faults, and connector wear.
  • Strong attention to detail when documenting revisions, discrepancies, root causes, and corrective actions.
  • Ability to rework harnesses in accordance with Engineering Change Orders and maintain accurate revision records.
  • Proactive communication skills, including the confidence to raise physical build issues and drawing discrepancies with engineering teams.
  • Ability to work inside prototype vehicles and in tight or physically demanding spaces.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 certification.
  • J-STD-001 soldering certification.
  • Experience working with harness CAD outputs such as Capital, RapidHarness, or CATIA Electrical.
  • Familiarity with JIRA for task and ticket management.
  • Experience building breakout boxes, test fixtures, instrumentation harnesses, or lab test equipment.
  • Experience creating redlined drawings, pinout revisions, wire lists, and as-built documentation.
  • Familiarity with Slack or similar collaboration tools.
  • Experience monitoring and maintaining inventory of wire, terminals, connectors, and related lab supplies.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • At least 2 years of relevant hands-on low-voltage wire harness experience.
  • No specific degree or formal educational background is required.
  • Practical experience with harness fabrication, vehicle wiring, electrical testing, and troubleshooting is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting prototype development, engineering changes, or complex electromechanical systems is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work location: Onsite and lab-based in Sunnyvale, California.
  • Schedule: Flexible start times between 6:00 AM and 9:00 AM; typically 45–50 hours per week.
  • Overtime may be approved based on business needs.
  • Approximately 15% national travel may be required to support regional vehicle testing and field activities. Potential international travel may also be available.
  • Must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity with an initial 6-month term and potential transition to direct hire.
  • Targeted start within approximately 2–3 weeks.
  • High-voltage electrical work is strictly outside the scope of this role.

job.title: Billing Associate
job.description:
Billing Associate

Overview

Join a collaborative billing team as a Billing Associate responsible for managing assigned accounts, processing claims, maintaining accurate accounts receivable records, and resolving billing issues. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who understands the fundamentals of billing, works confidently with data in Excel, and can communicate effectively with internal teams, consumers, outside agencies, and payers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process billing for assigned accounts and payers.
  • Follow up consistently on claims, rejected claims, and denied claims.
  • Investigate billing denials and resolve claims for payment.
  • Maintain accounts receivable spreadsheets, balances, and related records.
  • Research and resolve billing and claims issues with outside agencies.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to address consumer billing concerns.
  • Follow established billing procedures for all assigned tasks.
  • Report payer-related issues to senior team members and the Billing Supervisor.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  • Complete data entry and other duties assigned by the Billing Supervisor.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • High school diploma or higher.
  • Exposure to and a basic understanding of billing processes.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including basic formulas and working with data.
  • Experience working with large volumes of data in Excel or similar systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.
  • Professional, dependable, punctual, and self-motivated approach.
  • Ability to learn new information and procedures on a regular basis.
  • Familiarity with standard office equipment and technology.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow applicable privacy requirements.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Claims billing experience.
  • Reconciliation experience.
  • Experience using web-based billing portals.
  • Knowledge of claims billing software.
  • Experience with CRM systems or other tools used to manage large data sets.
  • Familiarity with Fiscal Intermediary or PCA program requirements.
  • Experience using Microsoft Outlook and Word in a professional environment.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • High school diploma required; some college coursework preferred.
  • Prior billing, claims processing, accounts receivable, reconciliation, or related administrative experience preferred.
  • Experience working with small or large data volumes in Excel or CRM software is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Stoughton, Massachusetts, five days per week initially. The opportunity to work from home up to two days per week may become available after the manager confirms the employee is ready.
  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
  • Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing assigned accounts independently.
  • Must be able to communicate professionally with staff, consumers, outside professionals, agencies, and payers.

job.title: Meetings Manager
job.description:
Meetings Manager

Overview

Lead the day-to-day execution of a high-growth Meetings at Events program supporting Sales, Marketing, and go-to-market teams. As an interim Meetings Manager, you will step into an established global program and take ownership of meeting operations, event logistics, reporting, enablement, communications, and cross-functional coordination. This is a hands-on role for an experienced meetings or events professional who can operate with minimal ramp-up, maintain continuity across concurrent events, and create a well-documented transition for the incoming full-time team member.

This is a remote, six-month contract opportunity with travel required for on-site event execution.

Required Skills

  • 4–5 years of experience in meetings, events, or program management within a B2B enterprise software environment.
  • Experience owning the day-to-day operations of a meetings or events program from intake through execution and follow-up.
  • Ability to quickly step into an established program and maintain operations with minimal ramp-up.
  • Strong meeting and event operations experience, including:
  • Meeting-request intake, triage, approvals, scheduling, and real-time changes.
  • Meeting-tool setup, configuration, go-live, and quality assurance.
  • Venue logistics and space planning, including room setup, signage, access, attendee tracking, and food and beverage.
  • Event-day coordination and on-site execution.
  • Experience coordinating event logistics, meeting space, timelines, stakeholders, and budgets.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to turn data exports into clear insights and leadership-ready recaps.
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to create clear enablement materials, process documentation, playbooks, guides, and program updates.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and event timelines under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently while aligning execution with program strategy.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing, Product, Sales, and event technology teams.
  • Ability to identify risks and dependencies, communicate issues clearly, and translate lessons learned into improved workflows.
  • Commitment to thorough documentation and clean operational handoffs.
  • Willingness to work outside standard hours when needed to support teams in other time zones.
  • Ability to travel as required for on-site event support.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Hands-on configuration experience with meeting and event platforms such as Jifflenow or RainFocus.
  • Experience with Tableau or other business intelligence and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with Asana.
  • Experience supporting global, first-party, and third-party events.
  • Experience developing training sessions, office hours, event support channels, and field communications.
  • Experience with pipeline attribution, event ROI reporting, and performance measurement against objectives.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data, technology, or industry events.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred education was not specified.
  • Preferred experience includes 4–5 years in meetings, events, or program management within a B2B enterprise software environment, with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end program operations.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Remote.
  • Engagement: Six-month interim contract.
  • Travel: Required for on-site event execution, including potential support for events in multiple regions.
  • Schedule: Flexibility to work off-hours may be required to align with regional teams across time zones.
  • Must be able to support meeting-tool go-live, event-day operations, post-event reporting, enablement, program communications, and documentation throughout the engagement.

job.title: Operations Logistics Associate
job.description:
Operations Logistics Associate

Join a forward-thinking team in fostering efficient manufacturing operations as an Operations Logistics Associate. This pivotal role is designed for detail-oriented professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments and are committed to ensuring smooth warehouse material flow, inventory accuracy, and operational excellence. Be instrumental in supporting production lines, optimizing material handling processes, and maintaining a safe and organized work environment. Your contributions will directly impact the company’s ability to meet customer expectations and uphold operational standards.

Required Skills:

  • Proven experience in warehouse operations or logistics, ideally 2 to 4 years with a bachelor’s degree or 4 to 6 years with a high school diploma or GED.
  • Proficiency in using warehouse management systems such as SAP.
  • Strong physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs and operate heavy warehouse equipment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and solve problems swiftly, especially under pressure.
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to adhere to safety standards and work in compliance with safety policies.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with inventory accuracy and systemic troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with 5S methodologies and safety shoe standards conforming to ASTM F 2412 and F 2413.
  • Prior experience in a manufacturing or assembly environment.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 2-4 years of relevant experience or a high school diploma/GED with 4-6 years of experience.
  • Prior exposure to SAP or similar enterprise resource planning systems is a plus.

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite work in Foster City, CA, with shift schedules including nights and weekends (Sunday-Thursday or Tuesday-Saturday).
  • Ability to work in a safety-conscious environment, including wearing PPE such as composite toe safety shoes from Day 1.
  • Willingness to participate in background checks, MVR checks, and drug screenings to ensure compliance with safety and company policies.

job.title: System Integration and Test Engineer
job.description:
System Integration and Test Engineer

Overview

Drive the integration, testing, and reliability of complex vehicle-centric systems in an onsite engineering role based in Foster City, California. As a System Integration and Test Engineer, you will apply your expertise in electric vehicle development, systems engineering, and hands-on testing to evaluate system performance across Motion, Body, and electrical/electronic architecture domains. Your work will help identify integration risks, resolve complex issues, and support reliable vehicle performance in service operations.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline
  • 6–8 years of experience in vehicle system development and testing roles
  • Experience with vehicle electrical architecture
  • Knowledge of automotive communication protocols, including:
  • CAN
  • LIN
  • Ethernet
  • Experience with instrumentation and data acquisition tools, such as:
  • Vector CANalyzer
  • ETAS INCA
  • Intrepid
  • CSM
  • Hands-on electrical troubleshooting experience using tools such as:
  • Digital multimeter
  • Oscilloscope
  • Electrical schematics
  • Saleae Logic Analyzer

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with real-time embedded control system development
  • Experience conducting testing in an xIL environment
  • Experience with Grafana and other data analysis toolsets

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline
  • 6–8 years of experience in vehicle system development and testing
  • Background in electric vehicle development, systems engineering, and hands-on vehicle testing

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite
  • Location: Foster City, CA
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Contract duration: 6 months
  • Anticipated start: ASAP

job.title: Payroll Director
job.description:
Payroll Director

Overview

Lead the future of payroll operations for a complex North American organization supporting more than 10,000 employees across multiple locations and a heavily unionized workforce. The Payroll Director will oversee end-to-end U.S. payroll delivery, lead and develop a high-performing payroll organization, ensure compliance with numerous Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs), and drive system modernization, automation, and continuous improvement.

This strategic leadership opportunity is ideal for a technically strong payroll executive who can balance operational excellence with innovation, build trusted cross-functional partnerships, and establish scalable payroll practices across a complex enterprise environment.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive payroll management experience within a large, complex North American organization of 10,000+ employees
  • 6+ years of experience managing and developing skilled payroll teams
  • Bachelor’s degree or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Extensive experience delivering payroll services in a heavily unionized environment with multiple CBAs
  • Strong understanding of federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations, labor laws, compliance requirements, and internal controls
  • Proven success implementing and managing large, multi-location U.S. payroll providers
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional payroll projects and organizational change initiatives
  • Strong expertise in time and attendance auditing, time control, leave tracking, and reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to align payroll systems and workflows with complex labor agreements
  • Exceptional verbal, written, interpersonal, analytical, and business-partnering skills
  • Strong leadership, coaching, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Ability to manage biweekly and semimonthly payroll operations with a high degree of accuracy and confidentiality

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with UKG HCM and payroll platforms
  • Strong experience with UKG Workforce Management, Kronos/Dimensions, and UTA
  • Transit industry experience
  • Experience supporting payroll operations for a workforce governed by complex CBAs
  • Background in business process digitalization and automation, including AI implementation
  • Experience developing payroll performance metrics, KPIs, and advanced reporting capabilities
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and French
  • Experience managing year-end tax activities, including W-2s, 1042-S, T4s, and Records of Employment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, human resources, or a related field; CPP certification may be considered in place of a degree
  • 10+ years of progressive payroll experience
  • 6+ years leading payroll teams in a large, multi-location organization
  • Experience supporting a complex, unionized workforce with multiple payroll cycles and labor agreements

Other Requirements

  • Remote or hybrid position; candidates located in the Boston area are preferred for a hybrid schedule of approximately 2–3 days onsite per week
  • Fully remote consideration requires strong UKG expertise and the ability to work Eastern Time hours
  • Standard working hours are 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time
  • Must be willing to work outside standard hours periodically to support California payroll processing
  • Must be able to manage confidential payroll information with discretion and maintain rigorous data security standards
  • Must be comfortable partnering with payroll, time and attendance, finance, human resources, and operational teams across multiple locations
  • Business casual work environment for onsite employees

job.title: Communications & Event Program Coordinator
job.description:
Communications & Event Program Coordinator

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of technology and innovation as a Communications & Event Program Coordinator. This vital role is designed for a highly organized, tech-savvy professional eager to spearhead seamless communications and memorable events in a fast-paced environment. As the connective hub between our communications and events teams, you will manage logistics, drive projects forward, and leverage modern AI tools to optimize efficiency—playing a key part in elevating our organizational presence and impact.

Required Skills:

  • 1–3 years of experience in PR, communications, events, or marketing (agency or in-house)
  • Exceptional organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail
  • Strong writing and editing abilities

job.title: Senior Accountant/Accounting Manager
job.description:
Senior Accountant / Accounting Manager

Overview

Take ownership of a critical accounting function with a growing, venture-backed clean energy and technology company. This hands-on role reports to the Controller and offers the opportunity to lead the general ledger, drive the month-end close, resolve complex accounting matters, and establish scalable processes in a lean, fast-moving startup environment.

You will work across Finance, FP&A, Operations, Inventory, and AP/AR to bring structure and clarity to a complex business involving hardware deployments, compute agreements, project partnerships, construction-in-progress, inventory, leases, and fixed assets. The ideal candidate is an independent, technically strong accounting professional who can investigate historical transactions, interpret contracts, and make sound accounting decisions with limited direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end close, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, account analysis, and financial statement preparation.
  • Close outstanding accounting periods and establish a consistent, reliable close process.
  • Prepare flux analysis and explain material variances to the Controller.
  • Independently manage and customize reports within QuickBooks Advanced or QuickBooks Enterprise.
  • Review customer and commercial agreements and support accounting conclusions under ASC 606 and ASC 842.
  • Maintain revenue, deferred revenue, and lease schedules.
  • Review billing schedules and deferred revenue rollforwards for alignment with contract terms and the general ledger.
  • Support consolidation and variable interest entity assessments under ASC 810.
  • Prepare consolidation entries, intercompany eliminations, or equity method accounting entries, as applicable.
  • Own project accounting for site deployments, including project setup, budget tracking, committed and actual cost analysis, and construction-in-progress balances.
  • Manage capital expenditure accounting, capitalization reviews, purchase order tracking, and monthly reporting.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register for deployed equipment, leased equipment, site infrastructure, and other operational assets.
  • Track inventory from raw materials through work-in-process, finished units, and field deployment.
  • Prepare inventory rollforwards, cycle count reconciliations, and reserve analyses.
  • Support multistate sales and use tax, nexus tracking, property tax, partnership tax, franchise tax, stock-based compensation schedules, and the income tax provision.
  • Review and provide oversight of accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
  • Investigate complex accounting issues at the transaction level and execute accurate corrective entries.
  • Help establish scalable accounting policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Support audit preparation and help ensure accounting records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Required Skills

  • 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience across public accounting and industry.
  • Demonstrated ownership of the month-end close process.
  • Expert-level proficiency with QuickBooks Advanced or QuickBooks Enterprise.
  • Ability to navigate QuickBooks independently, customize reports, and manage the general ledger.
  • Hands-on experience with journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, financial reporting, and flux analysis.
  • Working knowledge of ASC 606, including revenue recognition and contract assessment.
  • Working knowledge of ASC 842, including lease accounting and lessor accounting.
  • Experience with ASC 330 inventory, ASC 360 fixed assets, ASC 323 equity method accounting, and ASC 810 consolidation and variable interest entities.
  • Proven experience with project accounting, capital expenditures, construction-in-progress, and fixed asset capitalization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and determine their accounting implications.
  • Ability to work independently in an incomplete, evolving, or disorganized accounting environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to work hands-on with transactions, journal entries, schedules, and supporting documentation.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in an early-stage, venture-backed, hardware, infrastructure, energy, or high-growth technology company.
  • Experience with Ramp.
  • Experience supporting an ERP implementation or accounting systems transition.
  • Experience with inventory accounting in a manufacturing or hardware environment.
  • Experience with joint ventures, project entities, or multistate operations.
  • Experience supporting audit readiness in a growing organization.
  • Familiarity with stock-based compensation and income tax provision support.
  • Experience supervising or reviewing the work of AP/AR personnel.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field preferred.
  • Active CPA license or CPA candidacy preferred.
  • 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience, ideally including both public accounting and industry experience.
  • Experience owning the general ledger and close process, researching technical accounting matters, and improving accounting processes.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with a minimum of one onsite day per week.
  • Engagement: Contract opportunity expected to last 3–6+ months, with the possibility of extension or conversion to a permanent position.
  • Start timing: ASAP.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with the Controller, FP&A, Operations, Inventory, and AP/AR teams.
  • Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving startup environment that requires independence, adaptability, resourcefulness, and accountability.

job.title: Jr. Full Stack Software Engineer
job.description:

Are you an early-career developer eager to make an impact in a fast-paced, innovative environment? Join a dynamic team supporting complex cross-functional programs with your full-stack expertise. In this role, you'll work on building and enhancing internal tools that empower program managers and engineering teams to make data-driven decisions, all while gaining hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and real-world applications.

job.title: Senior Staff Accountant
job.description:
Senior Staff Accountant

Overview

A growing private SaaS organization is seeking a hands-on Senior Staff Accountant to support essential accounting operations within a fast-paced, evolving environment. Reporting to the VP of Finance, this role will take ownership of month-end close activities, general ledger accounting, reconciliations, SaaS invoicing, audit and tax support, and overall financial data accuracy.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized accounting professional who takes initiative, investigates issues independently, and consistently delivers accurate results on schedule. This opportunity is well suited for a reliable, adaptable self-starter who enjoys working with a lean finance team, managing high-volume responsibilities, and making an immediate impact without requiring step-by-step direction.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 2–4 years of progressive accounting experience
  • Experience contributing to or managing a full-cycle month-end close
  • Strong understanding of GAAP, including accruals, prepaids, reserves, and allowance for doubtful accounts
  • General ledger accounting and journal entry preparation experience
  • Experience completing accurate and timely bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Experience maintaining prepaid schedules and fixed asset registers
  • Experience recording payroll entries, taxes, benefits, and related liabilities
  • Experience overseeing accounts payable entry, coding, approvals, and posting
  • Hands-on experience with a cloud-based accounting system such as Intacct, NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, or Xero
  • Advanced Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs and pivot tables
  • Experience preparing provided-by-client schedules and supporting documentation for audits and tax filings
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, timely work
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to investigate issues independently and work effectively without detailed instructions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and high-volume work
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, reliability, and follow-through

Key Responsibilities

Month-End Close and General Ledger

  • Support accurate and timely month-end close activities
  • Record and reconcile monthly payroll entries, including taxes, benefits, and related liabilities
  • Complete bank reconciliations and resolve outstanding or aged reconciling items
  • Reconcile credit card activity and ensure transactions are properly coded and supported
  • Maintain prepaid schedules and record monthly amortization
  • Maintain the fixed asset register, record additions and disposals, post depreciation, and reconcile the register to the general ledger
  • Record accrued expenses and accrued interest in the appropriate accounting periods
  • Assess receivables aging and record an appropriate allowance for doubtful accounts
  • Prepare journal entries and maintain accurate general ledger records

Accounting Operations

  • Review the bill register regularly to identify errors, duplicates, and aging items
  • Oversee accounts payable entry and posting to ensure accurate coding and approval compliance
  • Prepare spend-management card activity reports
  • Post journal entries for bank activity not captured through other workflows
  • Maintain cash and bank tracking records to support visibility
  • Help ensure month-end close is completed accurately and on schedule

Tax, Audit, and Billing

  • Prepare provided-by-client schedules and supporting documentation for annual tax filings
  • Assemble audit support and respond to auditor requests
  • Own customer invoicing for SaaS subscriptions, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Support subscription billing and revenue-related accounting activities

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in SaaS, subscription billing, or the technology industry
  • Experience with SaaS invoicing and subscription revenue recognition
  • Familiarity with ASC 606
  • Experience using spend-management tools such as Brex or Ramp
  • Experience reviewing the work of others or mentoring junior accounting staff
  • Experience supporting external financial reporting
  • Experience collaborating with distributed or international teams
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous-improvement mindset

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline preferred
  • 2–4 years of progressive accounting experience
  • Experience managing or contributing to a full-cycle month-end close process
  • Experience in a SaaS, subscription-based, or high-growth business environment preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid in the Santa Clara, CA area, with approximately two days onsite per week during training; fully remote candidates may also be considered
  • Candidates should be located in the Pacific Time Zone
  • Part-time schedule of approximately 20–30 hours per week
  • Ability to begin promptly
  • Comfortable collaborating with a small finance team and colleagues based internationally
  • Self-starter with a positive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented approach
  • Ability to thrive in an unstructured environment, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple accounting responsibilities
  • Contract assignment expected to last approximately three months, with the possibility of extension

job.title: Software Developer in Test
job.description:
Software Developer in Test

Join a System Integration and Validation team focused on building reliable, scalable automation for safety-critical tools. As a Software Developer in Test, you will design and enhance integration automation frameworks, develop comprehensive functional and regression testing, and help reduce manual testing across product-level systems used by a customer fleet.

This role offers the opportunity to shape automation strategy, improve test coverage, investigate complex defects, and collaborate with developers, QA leads, and product managers to validate features across development, staging, and production environments.

job.title: Workday Consultant
job.description:
Workday Consultant

Overview

Drive planning transformation for higher education and public-sector organizations as a Workday Consultant. In this remote, client-facing contract role, you will help finance, budget, HR, and executive stakeholders modernize budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, reporting, and long-range financial planning through Workday Adaptive Planning.

You will combine expertise in higher education and/or government finance with hands-on solution design, model configuration, stakeholder engagement, and AI-accelerated delivery. From leading discovery workshops and translating business processes into scalable planning models to developing executive reporting and supporting go-live, you will help clients bring greater structure, accountability, and insight to complex financial environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery workshops with Finance, Budget, HR, Provost, Institutional Research, Student Affairs, department, and executive stakeholders.
  • Design and configure Workday Adaptive Planning models, dashboards, reports, and reporting solutions.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, enrollment and tuition revenue planning, long-range financial planning, grants and auxiliary planning, capital planning, and personnel budgeting initiatives.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate configuration, documentation, testing, analysis, and delivery while validating the quality and accuracy of AI-generated output.
  • Support the use of Workday Adaptive Decision Intelligence for scenario modeling, simulations, natural-language planning questions, and governed decision-making.
  • Translate organizational processes into scalable planning models and effective reporting solutions.
  • Conduct testing, validation, training, optimization, and go-live support.
  • Assist with roadmap development, optimization assessments, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to proposal development, demonstrations, and solution discussions.
  • Mentor junior consultants and support the development of consulting methodologies and AI accelerators.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
  • Higher education finance or budgeting
  • Government or public-sector budgeting and financial planning
  • FP&A or planning transformation consulting
  • Workday Adaptive Planning consulting or administration
  • Experience working within or supporting higher education institutions and/or government organizations.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, and financial reporting processes.
  • Experience leading client-facing meetings, discovery sessions, and workshops.
  • Ability to translate business processes into scalable planning models.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools professionally, including writing effective prompts, validating AI-generated output, and incorporating AI into daily delivery.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Experience supporting solution design, testing, validation, training, or go-live activities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with financial, operational, HR, academic, administrative, and executive stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Active Workday Adaptive Planning certification.
  • Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Decision Intelligence or scenario-based, AI-driven planning.
  • Experience with enrollment planning, tuition and financial aid modeling, or faculty demand and workload planning.
  • Experience with workforce planning, personnel budgeting, or vacancy management.
  • Experience with long-range financial planning, grants management, fund forecasting, auxiliary planning, capital planning, or strategic initiative planning.
  • Knowledge of budget book and ACFR reporting processes.
  • Experience integrating planning solutions with ERP and SIS platforms such as Banner, Workday, Colleague, PeopleSoft, Ellucian, Tyler Technologies, Munis, Oracle, or SAP.
  • Experience with OfficeConnect, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Experience applying AI tools to consulting, financial analysis, or modeling work.
  • Prior consulting experience.
  • Experience supporting proposals, demonstrations, or solution discussions.
  • Interest in mentoring junior consultants and contributing to consulting methodologies or AI accelerators.

Preferred Education and Experience

Relevant professional experience in higher education finance, government finance, public-sector planning, FP&A, Workday Adaptive Planning, or financial transformation consulting is preferred.

At least 4 years of relevant professional experience is required. Specific degree requirements were not provided.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Employment type: Contract or contract part-time.
  • Contract duration: 12 months or longer.
  • Travel: Periodic client travel may be required, generally less than 10% depending on project needs.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, autonomous, and client-facing consulting environment.
  • Commitment to quality, accountability, clear communication, and responsible use of AI in client delivery.
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible.

job.title: Program Manager - City & Customer Launches

job.title: XOPs Validation Engineer
job.description:
XOPs Validation Engineer

Overview

Join a hands-on engineering team focused on transforming early-stage electro-mechanical prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. As an XOPs Validation Engineer, you will serve as a critical connection between design engineering and cross-functional partners, developing and executing rigorous tests that expose design flaws, evaluate real-world performance, and accelerate product development.

This role is ideal for an experienced validation or reliability engineer who enjoys working directly with hardware, building creative test solutions, analyzing complex data, and investigating failures through root cause analysis.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of experience in hardware testing, reliability engineering, or validation of complex electro-mechanical products.
  • Experience working with products such as robotics, medical devices, automotive systems, or consumer electronics.
  • Ability to develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, protocols, and standard operating procedures.
  • Experience defining validation requirements in collaboration with design engineers.
  • Hands-on proficiency with laboratory equipment, including:
  • Oscilloscopes
  • Digital multimeters
  • Power supplies
  • Load cells
  • Basic soldering and rework tools
  • Experience setting up data acquisition systems and working with sensors such as temperature, voltage, strain, torque, and acoustics.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD for fixture design; CATIA experience is preferred.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or C++ for test automation and data parsing.
  • Strong understanding of statistical data analysis and Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Familiarity with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, including DFMEA and PFMEA.
  • Ability to conduct structural and functional testing, analyze results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience performing teardown investigations and root cause analysis of mechanical, electrical, and functional failures.

Preferred Education and Experience

Other Requirements
