job.title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise Storage Platform & Core OS
job.description:
About the Client & Opportunity

Our client is an industry leader in enterprise data storage platforms and next-generation data architecture. They are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the roadmap and strategy for their core enterprise storage operating system and underlying hardware platform infrastructure.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of enterprise software and hardware co-design. You will oversee critical platform initiatives, including controller optimization, flash media integration, fault tolerance/high availability, and seamless live updates.

Key Responsibilities


  • Core OS & Platform Roadmap: Own the product definition and strategic vision for core storage operating system services. Balance high-availability failover mechanisms, data reduction efficiency, and non-disruptive upgrade capabilities to maintain strict enterprise reliability standards.

  • Protocol & Systems Hardware Integration: Translate enterprise requirements across key block storage protocols (NVMe-oF, NVMe/TCP, Fibre Channel, iSCSI) into operational product specs that bridge new media and hardware controller innovations.

  • Data-Driven Roadmap Prioritization: Analyze system telemetry, benchmark analytics, and field performance data to uncover bottlenecks, optimize latency and throughput, and maintain a high-impact feature backlog.

  • Cross-Functional Co-Design: Partner closely with Platform Engineers, Systems QA, and Architecture teams to define technical acceptance criteria and deliver integrated hardware/software capabilities.

  • Field & Commercial Support: Create high-impact technical collateral, architectural positioning guides, and competitive insights to empower technical sales teams and enterprise customers.

Qualifications & Experience


  • Infrastructure Product Leadership: 5+ years of Product Management experience successfully defining and launching enterprise storage or infrastructure software capabilities.

  • Deep Storage Protocol Mastery: Hands-on expertise with block storage protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF/TCP) and internal storage OS mechanics (controller architecture, high availability/failover, non-disruptive upgrades).

  • Analytical & Telemetry Focus: Proven ability to leverage benchmark telemetry and system metrics (IOPS, throughput, latency, failure domain dynamics) to make data-backed product choices.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing engineering, hardware, and field teams without direct authority.


DeWinter Group and Maris Consulting is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We post pay scales which are based on our client pay ranges. DeWinter, Maris, and our clients have the right to modify the requirements of the role which can impact the pay ranges posted.

job.title: Sustaining Engineer
job.description:
Sustaining Engineer

Join a cutting-edge team dedicated to advancing autonomous mobility solutions. As a Sustaining Engineer, you will play a vital role in maintaining the reliability and operational readiness of our Level 3 Toyota Highlander fleet, supporting testing, mapping, and fleet deployment in a fast-paced, innovative environment. Your expertise will drive end-to-end resolution of vehicle and hardware issues, ensuring maximum fleet uptime and system robustness that directly impacts the future of autonomous transportation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and deliver sustaining engineering support for the test fleet, managing corrective actions from root cause analysis through successful implementation.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve electrical and mechanical system issues across OEM vehicle components and integrated AV hardware.
  • Lead design enhancements for Toyota subsystems to improve reliability, durability, and serviceability.
  • Develop and execute validation plans, author Engineering Change Requests, and lead fleet trials to verify long-term effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including service, manufacturing, and suppliers — to create scalable, manufacturable, and durable solutions.
  • Use fleet data, technician feedback, and reliability metrics like MTBF to prioritize work, validate corrective actions, and prevent recurrence.

Required Skills:

  • BS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field; MS preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in electrical/mechanical systems within product development, manufacturing, or sustaining environments.
  • Proven ability to improve subsystem reliability using root cause analysis, DFMEA, and validation testing.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Python, SQL, Vector CANalyzer, or Databricks for fleet data analysis and troubleshooting.
  • Strong communication, documentation skills, and proficiency with 3D CAD tools like CATIA.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with EV architectures, high voltage systems, or autonomous vehicle platforms.
  • Background in OEM vehicle development, release processes, or Toyota-specific systems.
  • Knowledge of electrical design tools and fleet data visualization solutions.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering disciplines; Master’s degree ideal.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in reliability, serviceability, or sustaining engineering within the automotive or high-tech sectors.

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite position in Foster City, CA (5 days/week).
  • Minimal domestic travel required.
  • Supporting a dynamic, high-impact testing and operational fleet environment.
  • This role is offered as W2 only.

Bring your expertise to a team revolutionizing transportation, ensuring our autonomous fleet operates at peak performance every mile of the way.

job.title: Sr AP Analyst
job.description:
Sr AP Analyst

Overview

Join a rapidly growing technology organization as a Sr AP Analyst and take ownership of critical accounts payable, corporate expense, and payment operations. This is an opportunity to make an immediate impact in a high-volume, fast-paced environment where processes are continuously evolving and strong financial controls are essential.

You will lead full-cycle accounts payable activities, manage corporate card and employee expense programs, support month-end close, and identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows. The ideal candidate is adaptable, highly organized, comfortable working with a lean team, and motivated to build scalable processes in a high-growth environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage full-cycle invoice processing, including invoice intake and verification, general ledger coding, approval routing, purchase order matching, and discrepancy resolution.
  • Oversee vendor onboarding, vendor master file administration, banking change controls, and audit-ready tax documentation.
  • Manage corporate card and spend management programs, including card issuance limits, policy compliance, receipt verification, and employee reimbursements.
  • Resolve vendor payment inquiries and internal expense escalations while maintaining organized tracking and resolution workflows.
  • Execute payment cycles, monitor settlement statuses, resolve rejected disbursements, and maintain appropriate segregation of duties.
  • Perform monthly reconciliations across corporate card activity, vendor payables, bank statements, and the general ledger.
  • Prepare payables aging reports, accrual entries, journal entries, corporate card reconciliations, and month-end close support schedules.
  • Analyze system integration errors, coding variances, missing documentation, pending approvals, and other operational exceptions.
  • Improve AP and expense processes across Ramp, Brex, and related accounting systems.
  • Develop standardized procedures, documentation, dashboards, and workflow improvements.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to validate data integrity, improve system integrations, and eliminate recurring process friction.
  • Use AI-enabled tools and automated workflows to improve compliance audits, reporting, and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in accounts payable, employee expense management, corporate cards, financial operations, or a related accounting function.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing full-cycle accounts payable, including:
  • Invoice intake and verification
  • General ledger coding
  • Purchase order matching
  • Approval routing
  • Vendor setup and maintenance
  • Payment processing
  • Issue resolution
  • Advanced experience administering Ramp, including approval workflows, transaction auditing, spend reporting, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with corporate card programs, employee reimbursements, receipt verification, and spend policy compliance.
  • Knowledge of vendor master file management, banking change controls, tax documentation, and audit-ready recordkeeping.
  • Proficiency with payment disbursements, payables aging, accruals, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Experience supporting month-end close and resolving variances across card platforms, ledgers, and bank statements.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls and segregation of duties.
  • Advanced Excel skills with the ability to analyze data, identify root causes, and maintain data integrity.
  • Ability to manage significant and fluctuating transaction volume, including purchase orders, non-PO invoices, and incomplete expense documentation.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and communication.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing deadlines, and collaborate effectively with employees, vendors, accounting, procurement, engineering, and other business partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Rillet, particularly AP, expense, reconciliation, and close workflows.
  • Experience with Brex.
  • Background in a high-growth technology or startup environment.
  • Experience supporting multiple entities or currencies.
  • Experience managing concurrent transaction integrations under tight deadlines.
  • Workflow automation or dashboard development experience.
  • Experience partnering with engineering or systems teams on integrations and process improvements.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and automated workflows.
  • Experience developing standardized operating procedures and process documentation.
  • CPA certification or progress toward CPA.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related quantitative field preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in accounts payable, corporate expenses, financial operations, or a related function.
  • Experience supporting month-end close in a high-volume, rapidly changing environment.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in San Francisco, ideally five days per week.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth organization with changing priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a lean team and take ownership from daily execution through continuous improvement.
  • Strong commitment to confidentiality, financial controls, accurate documentation, and timely issue resolution.
  • Contract duration is expected to be approximately 3–6 months, with potential for conversion based on business needs and performance.

job.title: Ignition SCADA Deveoper
job.description:
Ignition SCADA Developer

Overview

Build the monitoring and control layer that supports the reliable operation of high-density, mission-critical infrastructure. As an Ignition SCADA Developer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain applications that provide real-time visibility into electrical power, cooling, and mechanical systems across complex facilities.

This hands-on engineering role will transform data from PLCs, meters, coolant distribution units, chillers, switchgear, and other field devices into dependable dashboards, alarms, historical records, and integrations. Your work will help operations teams make informed decisions, respond to critical conditions, and keep essential infrastructure running reliably.

Required Skills

  • 5–7 years of experience in industrial automation, SCADA, or controls engineering.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on Ignition development experience, including one large, end-to-end deployment.
  • Strong experience with Ignition Perspective, tag modeling, UDTs, alarming, alarm pipelines, and Tag Historian.
  • Experience integrating industrial systems using Modbus TCP/RTU, BACnet, OPC UA, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with Python/Jython scripting and SQL queries.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Experience configuring and supporting Ignition gateway architecture, including redundancy, Gateway Network, Enterprise Administration Module, backups, and upgrades.
  • Ability to design and secure custom APIs through Ignition’s Webdev module or an equivalent technology.
  • Understanding of OT security practices, including network segmentation, role-based access, and audit logging.
  • Knowledge of OT networking concepts, including VLANs, firewalls, IP addressing, and secure remote access.
  • Ability to read electrical one-line diagrams, mechanical schematics, and controls sequences of operation.
  • Experience with PLCs or controllers from vendors such as Allen-Bradley, Schneider, Siemens, or Johnson Controls.
  • Ability to troubleshoot production issues and participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical monitoring systems.
  • Experience using Git and documented change-management processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills when collaborating with engineers, contractors, and operations teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Inductive Automation Ignition Core or Gold certification.
  • Experience working in mission-critical environments such as data centers, utilities, or manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with liquid cooling systems, including coolant distribution units and rear-door heat exchangers.
  • Experience with high-density rack power systems.
  • Knowledge of Ignition Edge, MQTT Sparkplug B, or Unified Namespace architectures.
  • Exposure to DCIM platforms and IT observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Kafka.
  • Knowledge of ISA/IEC 62443, ISA-18.2 alarm management, or ISA-101 HMI design standards.
  • Experience with containerized or infrastructure-as-code deployments of Ignition gateways.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, or Computer Engineering preferred.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 5–7 years of professional experience in industrial automation, SCADA, or controls engineering.
  • 3+ years of professional Ignition development experience.

Other Requirements

  • Design, build, and maintain Ignition applications for electrical power monitoring, building management, and liquid cooling systems.
  • Create reusable templates, UDTs, and tag structures to support consistent deployment across new sites.
  • Configure alarms, alarm pipelines, notifications, historical data pipelines, and custom APIs.
  • Support commissioning and integrated systems testing at new sites in collaboration with controls contractors, MEP engineers, and site operations teams.
  • Apply documented change-management practices and source control to project updates.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical monitoring systems.
  • Work arrangement—remote or onsite—was not specified in the provided job details.
  • Travel requirements were not specified in the provided job details.

job.title: Workplace Operations Associate
job.description:
Workplace Operations Associate

Overview

Be the welcoming presence and operational heartbeat of a dynamic New York City workplace. As a Workplace Operations Associate, you’ll create seamless, hospitality-focused experiences for employees, candidates, clients, and guests while keeping the office organized, well-stocked, and running smoothly.

From managing the front desk and visitor experience to coordinating vendors, supporting workplace events, and resolving day-to-day facilities needs, you’ll play a hands-on role in shaping an engaging and productive office environment. This is an ideal opportunity for a proactive, people-focused professional who enjoys variety, thrives in a high-energy setting, and takes pride in making the workplace experience exceptional.

Required Skills

  • Exceptional customer service, hospitality, and communication skills
  • Warm, professional, and welcoming demeanor with a genuine interest in helping others
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Proactive, resourceful approach to solving workplace and facilities challenges
  • Ability to respond effectively to daily requests, room reservation issues, supply needs, and building-related concerns
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, including tools such as Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, or Slack
  • Ability to learn and use visitor management systems, ticketing platforms, and other workplace technology
  • Strong attention to detail when maintaining visitor records, safety logs, emergency contacts, directories, and other documentation
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, building management, and external vendors
  • Comfortable supporting office events, catering setups, meeting rooms, and presentation technology
  • Ability to maintain an organized, clean, and inviting workplace environment

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with front-desk administration, workplace operations, hospitality, retail, or customer service
  • Familiarity with visitor check-in processes and badge management
  • Experience coordinating catering, office events, team gatherings, or workplace celebrations
  • Experience working with janitorial, catering, plant maintenance, or building management vendors
  • Familiarity with basic vendor invoice processing and office inventory management
  • Experience supporting conference room scheduling and audiovisual setup

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent practical experience
  • 0–2 years of experience in customer service, hospitality, retail, front-desk administration, or workplace operations

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite
  • Location: One World Trade Center, New York City
  • Schedule: Onsite five days per week
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Assignment length: Approximately six months
  • Must be comfortable performing daily office walkthroughs and supporting reception, meeting rooms, kitchenettes, common areas, events, and workplace logistics
  • Must be able to manage a highly interactive role involving employees, guests, candidates, clients, vendors, and building personnel

job.title: ECAD Library & PLM Engineer
job.description:
ECAD Library & PLM Engineer

Overview:
Join an innovative company at the forefront of hardware design and development as an ECAD Library & PLM Engineer. This role is vital for maintaining and advancing the electrical component library and ensuring seamless integration between ECAD and PLM systems. You will lead efforts to optimize library management, support manufacturing and NPI processes, and collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to drive data quality and process efficiency in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping the electronic design infrastructure that underpins cutting-edge product innovation.

Required Skills:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Altium Designer, including Altium 365, vaults, managed components, and library workflows
  • Proven ability to manage ECAD libraries end-to-end: schematic symbols, PCB footprints, models, and metadata
  • Strong knowledge of PLM system administration, ideally Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE / ENOVIA, including workflows and change management
  • Experience integrating ECAD and PLM systems, ensuring data synchronization and BOM consistency
  • Familiarity with CATIA and MCAD-ECAD data exchange protocols such as IDX/IDF and STEP
  • Solid understanding of electronics components, packages, datasheets, tolerances, and manufacturer part numbering standards
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to improve and maintain data quality initiatives like duplicate detection, obsolescence, EOL, and alternative parts

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior support for automotive, aerospace, or other regulated hardware programs
  • Experience with automotive component qualification standards (AEC-Q100/Q200) and functional safety documentation
  • Participation in PLM implementation, migration, or major upgrades
  • Experience supporting PCB layout for high-layer count boards (10+ layers)

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 6+ years of experience managing ECAD libraries, PLM systems, or electrical design data in hardware product environments

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite role based in Foster City, CA; candidates must be able to work onsite 5 days per week
  • Strong collaboration with mechanical engineering teams on CATIA/3DX interoperability for PCB 3D models and enclosure fit checks
  • Commitment to ensuring quality and accuracy in library data and electrical parts management to support manufacturing and NPI processes

job.title: IT Internal Auditor
job.description:
IT Internal Auditor — SOX Contractor

Overview

Join a high-growth SaaS organization as an IT Internal Auditor and help strengthen the technology control environment during a period of rapid innovation. In this hands-on, six-month contract role, you will assess SOX compliance, evaluate IT risks associated with newly implemented AI tools, and support the design and testing of effective IT controls.

Working closely with IT teams, business process owners, internal stakeholders, and external auditors, you will evaluate control design, perform operating effectiveness testing, identify gaps, and support timely remediation. This is an opportunity to apply deep IT audit expertise in a fast-paced technology environment where your work will directly support evolving systems and business processes.

Required Skills

  • At least eight years of IT audit experience within a Big 4 public accounting firm, major consulting organization, or internal audit function
  • Strong hands-on experience with SOX IT General Controls (ITGCs) and IT Application Controls (ITACs)
  • Experience designing and executing ITGC and ITAC testing procedures across technology platforms and financial applications
  • Knowledge of controls related to:
  • Logical access
  • Access provisioning and deprovisioning
  • User access reviews
  • Change management
  • Computer operations
  • Systems development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Experience evaluating IT risks associated with SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and newly implemented technologies
  • Ability to assess automated workflows and data integrity within identity governance and access management processes
  • Experience evaluating access provisioning, deprovisioning, and user access review workflows
  • Experience with key report testing, including validation of report logic, parameters, completeness, and accuracy
  • Ability to assess input, interface, processing, and output controls
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain risks, issues, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to prepare audit-ready work papers and documentation using AuditBoard or a similar GRC platform
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential information

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience assessing AI agents or AI-enabled tools and designing related ITGCs and ITACs
  • Background working in a high-growth SaaS or technology organization
  • Familiarity with COSO and emerging AI governance frameworks within a SOX environment
  • Experience with financial and business processes such as quote-to-cash, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, or accounts payable
  • Experience supporting operational audits, financial audits, or additional internal audit projects
  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, ERP systems, and enterprise applications
  • Experience creating process and data flow diagrams using Lucidchart, Visio, or comparable tools
  • Experience supporting process improvements for SOX or internal audit programs
  • CISA, CISSP, CPA, or an equivalent professional certification

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field
  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT audit, risk assurance, SOX compliance, or internal audit
  • Experience in a Big 4, consulting, or high-growth technology environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while partnering effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and audit leadership

Other Requirements

  • Six-month contract assignment
  • Full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week
  • Hybrid work arrangement requiring three days onsite in Palo Alto and two days remote each week
  • Reliable ability to commute to the Palo Alto worksite
  • Immediate availability is preferred

job.title: Senior Technical Systems Analyst/Systems Engineer
job.description:
Senior Technical Systems Analyst / Systems Engineer

Overview

Join a high-impact technology team developing cloud-native software platforms within a complex automotive environment. As a Senior Technical Systems Analyst / Systems Engineer, you will serve as a key technical bridge between Product Management, Software Engineering, and Project Management—transforming product vision into precise technical requirements, scalable system designs, and execution-ready delivery plans.

You will evaluate technical feasibility, author Technical Requirement Documents, define API contracts, map system dependencies, investigate integration issues, and support delivery through structured engineering processes and formal verification gates. This opportunity is ideal for a technically fluent systems professional who excels at turning ambiguity into actionable direction and guiding cross-functional teams from initial requirements through delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate product requirements into detailed Technical Requirement Documents, technical specifications, and execution plans.
  • Define and review API specifications and contracts using REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI 3.0, and Swagger.
  • Create sequence diagrams, document system interactions, and map cross-module software dependencies.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility, identify scope gaps, and surface assumptions, edge cases, and error scenarios before development begins.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to clarify requirements and align technical direction.
  • Partner with Software Engineering teams on Agile planning, backlog execution, effort estimation, and delivery scheduling.
  • Investigate integration test failures and system anomalies using logs, performance traces, and observability data.
  • Support root-cause analysis and resolution efforts with backend and engineering teams.
  • Help align software development activities with structured engineering processes and formal verification gates.
  • Organize test results, verification artifacts, and evidence packages required for evaluation and release readiness.
  • Maintain clear, accurate technical documentation throughout the software development lifecycle.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • At least five years of hands-on experience as a Systems Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Solution Architect, Technical Program Manager, or similar professional supporting cloud-native software.
  • Proven ability to translate product requirements into detailed technical specifications and Technical Requirement Documents.
  • Strong knowledge of API specifications and integrations, including REST, GraphQL, and gRPC.
  • Experience creating or reviewing API contracts using OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger.
  • Ability to create sequence diagrams, define system interactions, and map software dependencies.
  • Experience conducting technical feasibility analysis and identifying scope ambiguities, assumptions, edge cases, and error conditions.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting integration issues using logs, performance traces, and observability platforms such as DataDog and AWS CloudWatch.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Postman, Swagger, Jama Software, and AWS CloudWatch.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, requirements management, testing, and release readiness.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Business English fluency, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Software Engineering, Project Management, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Japanese language proficiency at JLPT N2 level or equivalent.
  • Experience working with automotive software platforms or connected-vehicle technologies.
  • Experience with ASPICE lifecycle processes, V-Model compliance, or other high-reliability software development frameworks.
  • Familiarity with ASPICE SYS.1–SYS.5 and SWE.1–SWE.6 process areas.
  • Experience working within ISO 26262 or another functional safety framework.
  • Experience supporting Agile sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution.
  • Experience gathering engineering estimates and developing project schedules.
  • Experience preparing verification artifacts, test documentation, and evidence packages for formal evaluation gates.
  • Experience analyzing system performance, integration failures, and backend service behavior.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed or cross-regional engineering teams.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of relevant professional experience in cloud-native software, systems engineering, technical analysis, solution architecture, or technical program delivery.
  • Professional experience in automotive or another highly structured software development environment.
  • Experience supporting requirements, architecture, integration, testing, and release activities across the software development lifecycle.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% onsite in Mountain View, California.
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Pacific Time.
  • Engagement: Contract-to-hire with an initial six-month contract.
  • Candidates must be able to work onsite five days per week during the required schedule.
  • Japanese language proficiency is highly valued for cross-regional collaboration.
  • Candidates must be comfortable organizing technical information, communicating across disciplines, documenting system decisions, and maintaining accurate delivery and verification records throughout the software development lifecycle.

job.title: Order Management Lead
job.description:
Order Management Lead

Overview

Lead global order management operations for a fast-paced SaaS organization during an approximately three-month temporary leave coverage assignment. In this hands-on leadership role, you’ll coordinate across Salesforce, Product, Deal Desk, Revenue Accounting, GTM, and NetSuite to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely order processing throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.

As the final reviewer for opportunities moving to closed/won, you’ll validate order completeness, resolve deal exceptions and booking blockers, monitor critical data flows, and strengthen audit-ready controls. This is an opportunity for an experienced order management professional to make an immediate impact across systems, processes, and global stakeholders.

Required Skills

  • 6+ years of experience in SaaS order management, Deal Desk, revenue accounting, billing, or a related function
  • Demonstrated expertise with Salesforce CPQ and NetSuite
  • Strong understanding of bookings policies, revenue recognition principles, and SOX control frameworks
  • Experience reviewing contracts, validating order completeness, and resolving deal or booking exceptions
  • Ability to manage order data flows across Salesforce, Product platforms, and NetSuite
  • Proven ability to conduct root cause analysis and drive process or system improvements
  • Experience leading or mentoring global teams across multiple time zones
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and resolve issues in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with dashboards, reports, and operational data
  • Excellent written, verbal, and cross-functional communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with order synchronization or integration tools such as Celigo
  • Familiarity with Jira, Looker, Avalara, Google Workspace, and other quote-to-cash or order-to-cash tools
  • Experience creating exception-handling playbooks, standard operating procedures, or process documentation
  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close activities
  • Experience assisting with internal or external audits related to order operations
  • Background in a scale-up or post-merger environment
  • Experience partnering with Deal Desk, GTM, Revenue Accounting, Finance, Legal, Product, or Sales teams

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Six or more years of relevant experience in SaaS order management, Deal Desk, revenue accounting, billing, or a closely related field
  • Experience supporting complex quote-to-cash operations in a global organization
  • No specific degree or educational credential is required

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote
  • Engagement: Approximately three-month temporary assignment
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across time zones
  • Ability to support month-end and quarter-end close activities as needed
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce CPQ and NetSuite
  • Comfort working in a hands-on operational leadership role and managing day-to-day order management activities during a leave coverage period

job.title: SAP S/4 Hana Implementation Program Manager
job.description:
SAP S/4HANA Implementation Program Manager

Overview

Lead a high-impact global ERP transformation as the primary U.S.-based program leader for an SAP S/4HANA implementation within a regulated pharmaceutical environment. This role will guide the transition from QuickBooks Desktop to SAP S/4HANA across U.S. and India-based operations, including newly established manufacturing facilities.

You will oversee implementation execution from the client perspective, manage the system integrator, coordinate consulting and stakeholder teams, and drive alignment across business, technology, and operational priorities. This is an opportunity for an experienced, consultative program leader to shape manufacturing and supply chain processes while ensuring disciplined governance, effective change management, and successful program delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the global SAP S/4HANA implementation, including timelines, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and resources.
  • Manage the system integrator and coordinate consulting teams and client stakeholders.
  • Oversee PMO activities, implementation governance, change management, and internal controls.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data migration, including data cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Advise on manufacturing and supply chain processes, including demand planning, inventory, and fulfillment.
  • Facilitate collaboration among U.S.- and India-based teams across multiple time zones.
  • Build trust with stakeholders, challenge implementation decisions when appropriate, and take ownership of complex transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, implementation decisions, and program outcomes.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience leading complex SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP transformation programs.
  • Experience with ERP implementations, ideally including a greenfield implementation.
  • Strong project and program management expertise, including oversight of schedules, risks, resources, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Experience managing system integrators, cross-functional teams, and global stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of supply chain management, manufacturing processes, and business operations.
  • Experience with data migration strategy and oversight, including cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Knowledge of change management, internal controls, PMO activities, and implementation governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence diverse teams, navigate ambiguity, challenge implementation decisions, and take ownership of complex transformation initiatives.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across U.S. and India-based teams and multiple time zones.
  • English fluency.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, or another regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Hindi language skills.
  • Experience working with global teams across the United States and India.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing and supply chain software landscapes beyond SAP.
  • Cultural awareness and experience working within diverse organizational environments.
  • PMP certification.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of senior project or program management experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading global SAP S/4HANA or ERP implementations.
  • Experience overseeing large-scale transformation programs involving business process alignment, data migration, organizational change, and governance.
  • Background in pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Six-month engagement with potential for extension.
  • Full-time commitment of approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Hybrid position based in Princeton, New Jersey, with approximately three to four days onsite each week.
  • Availability to coordinate with teams across multiple time zones.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for project milestones and stakeholder engagements.
  • Ability to start as soon as possible.

job.title: HIL-SRS Data Center Technician
job.description:
HIL-SRS Data Center Technician

Overview

Support the test infrastructure that helps validate autonomous vehicle software as a HIL-SRS Data Center Technician. This onsite role is responsible for building, maintaining, configuring, and troubleshooting simulation machines and test platforms used throughout the autonomous software development process. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to keep hardware, networking, and lab systems operating reliably and predictably.

Required Skills

  • Knowledge of automotive CAN bus networks
  • Experience using Linux and running scripts
  • Working knowledge of Google Suite, JIRA, and Confluence
  • Proficiency with digital multimeters and oscilloscopes
  • Ability to read and understand electrical schematics
  • Experience building and troubleshooting computers
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks effectively
  • Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair test hardware
  • Experience building and repairing harnesses based on electrical diagrams

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and track configurations of test platforms
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair test hardware
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues
  • Build and repair electrical harnesses using schematics and diagrams
  • Assemble, install, and configure computers
  • Install vehicle system components into server racks
  • Build out networking infrastructure
  • Clearly document progress on tasks and projects
  • Maintain lab tools and equipment

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working in an autonomous vehicle environment
  • Data center experience
  • IPC certification
  • Familiarity with engineering test infrastructure and simulation systems

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: Model Maker - Additive Focus
job.description:

As a Model Maker with an additive manufacturing focus, you’ll work hands-on with engineers, designers, and prototype fabrication specialists to select the right materials and processes, operate multiple 3D-printing platforms, and transform experimental concepts into accurate, finished physical parts. This is an onsite, highly collaborative role where your craftsmanship, technical judgment, and ability to move quickly will directly support high-impact development work.

Required Skills

  • Ability to review CAD designs for printability and provide Design for Additive Manufacturing feedback.
  • Experience assembling prototypes and integrating printed parts with CNC-machined, laser-cut, purchased, and electronic components.
  • Ability to manage an assigned request queue, prioritize work, and meet deadlines with light supervision.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, and other fabrication disciplines.
  • Ability to perform routine equipment maintenance and first-line troubleshooting.

Nice-to-Have Skills

job.title: Tax Consultant
job.description:
Tax Consultant — SaaS Sales Tax & Tax Provision

Overview

Support a high-impact tax remediation and year-end tax initiative for a growing SaaS technology organization. This fully remote, hands-on consulting engagement will initially focus on investigating and remediating historical U.S. sales and use tax exposure, including multistate compliance, economic nexus, SaaS taxability, registrations, filings, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

As the engagement progresses, you will transition into direct tax responsibilities, including year-end tax provision preparation and audit support. The ideal candidate is an independent, execution-focused tax professional who can analyze detailed transaction data, collaborate with General Ledger and Revenue teams, and develop practical solutions with minimal oversight.

Required Skills

  • Four or more years of relevant experience in corporate tax, public accounting, or tax consulting.

  • Strong understanding of multistate sales tax compliance, including:
  • Economic nexus
  • SaaS taxability
  • State registrations
  • Sales tax filings
  • Experience investigating and resolving sales tax discrepancies, historical exposures, and compliance issues.
  • Ability to analyze transaction-level data, billing records, tax data, and general ledger activity.
  • Experience preparing reconciliations, schedules, workpapers, and supporting documentation.
  • Foundational knowledge of corporate income taxation.
  • Familiarity with tax provision processes under ASC 740.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with financial, billing, tax, and transaction data.
  • Ability to work independently, research unfamiliar issues, and execute solutions without extensive direction.
  • Willingness to perform detailed, hands-on work regardless of previous title or management experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with General Ledger, Revenue, Tax, Accounting, and audit stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Previous in-house Tax Senior or Tax Manager experience within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Experience conducting historical sales tax exposure analyses and remediation initiatives.
  • Experience with voluntary disclosure agreements, state registrations, and delinquent tax filings.
  • Experience supporting quarterly or annual tax provision preparation under ASC 740.
  • Familiarity with Anrok, NetSuite, Chargebee, or Stripe.
  • Experience with tax technology, billing platforms, and enterprise resource planning systems.
  • Experience supporting tax audits, tax research, tax notices, or broader tax process improvement initiatives.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Four or more years of relevant experience in corporate tax, public accounting, or tax consulting, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
  • Experience supporting both indirect tax and direct tax activities is preferred.
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Start date: ASAP.
  • Engagement: Initially three months, with potential for extension and/or conversion.
  • Comfortable supporting an immediate sales tax remediation initiative before transitioning into year-end direct tax and tax provision work.
  • Ability to manage detailed, deadline-sensitive work and maintain organized documentation across multiple tax matters.
  • Comfortable partnering virtually with cross-functional accounting and finance teams.

job.title: Signal Integrity Engineer
job.description:
Signal Integrity Engineer

Overview

Join a growing hardware engineering team focused on advancing high-speed electronic systems. As a Signal Integrity Engineer, you will lead end-to-end signal integrity analysis across PCBs, chip packages, substrates, components, and interconnects—helping optimize channel performance from early pre-silicon modeling through design iteration and, when needed, post-silicon validation.

You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary engineering team to build 3D electromagnetic models, evaluate complex high-speed interfaces, identify signal performance bottlenecks, and guide design decisions that support reliable, production-ready systems. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on pre-silicon 3D electromagnetic modeling and channel data extraction, with the remaining time dedicated to signal integrity analysis, design iteration, and cross-functional collaboration.

Required Skills

  • 5–10+ years of dedicated experience in signal integrity and packaging analysis.
  • Expert proficiency with:
  • Ansys HFSS
  • Ansys SIwave
  • Keysight ADS
  • Proven experience analyzing high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, UCIe, and SerDes.
  • Experience conducting full-system signal integrity analysis across components, substrates, chip packages, and PCB designs.
  • Ability to build and extract 3D electromagnetic models for packages, boards, substrates, and interconnect paths.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Eye diagrams
  • Jitter
  • Insertion loss
  • Return loss
  • Crosstalk
  • S-parameter analysis
  • Solid knowledge of PCB stack-up architecture, material properties, routing rules, and high-speed design fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret simulation results, identify signal performance issues, and recommend design improvements.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional hardware engineering teams.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience automating simulation workflows and post-processing using Python, JavaScript, or Ocean/SKILL scripting.
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory characterization equipment, including:
  • Vector network analyzers (VNAs)
  • Time-domain reflectometers (TDRs)
  • High-speed oscilloscopes
  • Experience with model-to-measurement correlation.
  • Exposure to post-silicon lab bring-up and measurement validation.
  • Experience with DDR memory channels and related high-speed design analysis.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 5–10+ years of relevant industry experience in signal integrity, packaging analysis, high-speed design, or a related discipline.
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided.

Other Requirements

  • This role is available remotely or in a hybrid arrangement.
  • Hybrid work locations are available in Boston, MA, or San Jose, CA.
  • Employment may be available on a contract or full-time basis.
  • Ability to support pre-silicon 3D electromagnetic modeling, channel data extraction, signal integrity analysis, and design iteration.
  • Post-silicon lab bring-up, measurement validation, and correlation may be required as needed.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Hardware Design Consultant
job.description:
Senior Machine Learning Hardware Design Consultant

Overview

Join a specialized hardware engineering team developing next-generation machine learning accelerator IP. As a Senior Machine Learning Hardware Design Consultant, you will design and implement complex core logic that enables high-performance ML hardware, translating mathematically sophisticated algorithms into efficient, synthesizable hardware implementations.

This is a hands-on ASIC design role for an experienced digital hardware engineer—not a machine learning software position. You will contribute across the design lifecycle, from microarchitecture definition and RTL development through integration, timing closure, verification support, and silicon bring-up. Working closely with architecture, verification, physical design, firmware, and broader hardware teams, you will help optimize performance, power, area, and overall Quality of Results (QOR).

Required Skills

  • Strong digital hardware and logic design fundamentals
  • Expert-level RTL design experience using Verilog and/or SystemVerilog
  • Proven experience designing complex blocks from specification and microarchitecture through RTL implementation and integration
  • Experience implementing complex algorithms or computational features in hardware
  • Several years of experience working with machine learning-related hardware or algorithms
  • Strong understanding of the mathematics underlying machine learning, graphics, and/or digital signal processing algorithms
  • Experience translating mathematically complex concepts into efficient, performance-sensitive hardware
  • Hands-on experience with synthesis, timing constraints, timing closure, and DFT concepts
  • Experience collaborating with physical design engineers to achieve timing closure
  • Strong understanding of QOR and hardware optimization for power, performance, and area
  • Ability to design specialized core logic rather than general peripheral or side logic
  • Understanding of microarchitectural trade-offs, datapath and control logic design, and block-level optimization
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across architecture, verification, physical design, firmware, and hardware engineering teams

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience designing machine learning accelerator hardware
  • Experience with 3D graphics hardware
  • Experience with digital signal processing hardware or algorithms
  • Experience integrating blocks into larger SoCs
  • Experience with Synopsys design tools
  • Exposure to firmware or driver development
  • Experience with other ASIC and hardware design toolsets; tool-specific experience is secondary to deep design expertise

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field preferred
  • At least 5 years of ASIC design experience, with a strong focus on block-level RTL design and silicon development
  • 10+ years of digital or hardware design experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success taking blocks from microarchitecture and RTL through working silicon
  • Experience applying machine learning, graphics, DSP, or related algorithms to hardware implementations

Other Requirements

  • Location: San Jose, CA
  • Work arrangement: Onsite preferred; flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly specialized, and performance-sensitive hardware development environment
  • Availability to begin within approximately four weeks is preferred
  • Two positions are available

job.title: PHM Monitor Development Engineer
job.description:
Join Our Innovative Team as a PHM Monitor Development Engineer

Are you passionate about advancing autonomous vehicle technology through cutting-edge prognostics and health monitoring? We are seeking a talented PHM Monitor Development Engineer to design and deploy sophisticated offline health monitoring algorithms that will directly impact the safety, reliability, and maintenance efficiency of autonomous fleets. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-driven vehicle diagnostics, enabling predictive maintenance and enhancing operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define technical requirements and develop prognostic models to predict hardware failures and estimate Remaining Useful Life (RUL).
  • Design and implement offline diagnostic algorithms utilizing batch telemetry, sensor logs, and maintenance data.
  • Perform large-scale data extraction, feature engineering, and model training using PySpark on Databricks.
  • Engineer, package, and deploy models within robust pipelines while creating intuitive dashboards for fleet monitoring.
  • Develop alerting strategies, perform rigorous back-testing, and ensure high model accuracy with minimal false positives.
  • Deliver comprehensive technical documentation to facilitate smooth handovers and future enhancements.

Required Skills:

  • BS in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Prognostics & Health Management, predictive maintenance, or reliability engineering.
  • Proficiency in Python, PySpark, and experience with Databricks platform.
  • Strong knowledge of time-series analysis, anomaly detection, survival analysis, and machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
  • Expertise in signal processing techniques including FFT, wavelet transforms, and filtering.
  • Experience deploying analytical workflows with tools like Docker, Apache Airflow, or cloud data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with hardware degradation models, FMEA/FMECA, and telemetry data integration.
  • Proficient in version control and data manipulation at scale.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Previous experience in the Automotive or Aerospace sectors.
  • Knowledge of large-scale data storage and querying (SQL, Spark).
  • Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Engineering or Data Science.
  • Experience working on autonomous vehicle or robotics projects.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years focused on developing predictive models for complex hardware systems.
  • Direct experience with backend algorithm development and deployment in high-tech environments.

Additional Requirements:

  • This is a remote-friendly role but may require on-site visits in Foster City, CA.
  • Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced setting.

Elevate your career by contributing to groundbreaking autonomous vehicle technology that sets new standards for safety and efficiency. Join us in shaping the future of mobility.

job.title: Computer System Validation Manager
job.description:
Computer System Validation Manager

Overview

Lead critical computer system validation initiatives supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology operations in a hybrid role based in Redwood City, CA. As a Computer System Validation Manager, you will partner with Information Sciences, Quality Assurance, business owners, project teams, and vendors to plan and execute risk-based validation activities for new implementations and changes to existing GxP systems.

This role offers the opportunity to apply strong technical judgment across the system lifecycle, ensure data integrity and intended use, support inspection readiness, and guide multiple complex projects with minimal supervision. You will play a key role in validating cloud-based and SaaS platforms, assessing emerging AI capabilities, supporting data migrations, and strengthening CSV procedures and documentation.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10 or more years of GxP computer system validation experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
  • Substantial hands-on experience delivering validation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • GxP requirements
  • 21 CFR Part 11
  • EU Annex 11
  • GAMP 5
  • Computerized system data integrity principles and controls
  • Demonstrated ability to apply risk-based CSV methods and computer software assurance (CSA) principles across the system lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of software development and lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience authoring, reviewing, and assessing validation documentation, including:
  • Validation plans
  • User requirements
  • Functional and configuration specifications
  • Risk assessments
  • Test protocols
  • Requirements traceability matrices
  • Validation summary reports
  • Experience executing or coordinating validation testing, documenting objective evidence, investigating discrepancies, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, change control, remediation, and software upgrades.
  • Experience validating cloud-based SaaS systems and evaluating vendor documentation within a risk-based validation strategy.
  • Experience working with study-level electronic systems, including:
  • Electronic data capture (EDC)
  • Interactive response technology (IRT)
  • Pharmacovigilance (PV) databases
  • Experience assessing electronic records and electronic signatures requirements.
  • Experience assessing data integrity controls, including access management, audit trails, and electronic signatures.
  • Ability to support CSV-related deviations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), audits, regulatory inspections, and remediation activities.
  • Ability to lead multiple complex projects with minimal supervision while meeting agreed timelines.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, QA, business stakeholders, vendors, and all levels of management.

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: CAD Engineer - HV Dist & Charging System
job.description:
CAD Engineer - HV Distribution & Charging System

Join a forward-thinking team at the forefront of high-voltage electrical design in the rapidly evolving mobility industry. As a CAD Engineer specializing in HV Distribution and Charging Systems, you will develop critical components that power innovative electric vehicles, impacting sustainable transportation worldwide. Your expertise will drive the design and optimization of high-voltage junction boxes, insulator trays, busbars, and harness routing—key elements necessary for cutting-edge vehicle architectures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop mechanical components including enclosures, brackets, and assemblies for high-voltage systems.
  • Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V6 that meet rigorous specifications.
  • Manage updates and revisions of models in collaboration with part and assembly owners.
  • Generate parametric content for standard model libraries to support efficient design reuse.
  • Assist packaging teams by developing CAD for mock-ups, restriction geometries, and volume definitions.
  • Support manufacturing readiness with robust, manufacturable designs considering plastic and metallic part processes.
  • Conduct design reviews, including tolerance stack-ups and interface analyses, ensuring alignment with system requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Mechatronics and electrical engineers, to define and refine integrated solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience in 3D CAD modeling, preferably with CATIA V6.
  • Proficiency in creating fully parametric solids, including Boolean operations and sketches.
  • Strong understanding of plastic and metallic part design and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to conduct basic tolerance analyses and stack-ups.
  • Knowledge of Mechatronics system integration, PCB assembly (PCBA), and interface development.
  • Skilled in interpreting and generating drawings compliant with ASME Y14.5 standards and GD&T principles.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Google Docs, and project management tools such as JIRA.
  • Customer-centric mindset with flexibility to work varied hours as needed.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with 3DX or similar advanced CAD platforms.
  • Background in high-voltage or automotive electrical systems design.
  • Knowledge of DFx activities and design for manufacturability considerations.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in the automotive, transportation, or electric vehicle industry is a plus.

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is based on-site in Foster City, CA, with the possibility of flexible working arrangements.
  • No travel requirements.
  • Valid certifications related to mechanical or electrical design are beneficial but not mandatory.

Embark on a career that powers the future of sustainable mobility, crafting the high-voltage systems that make electric vehicles safer, more reliable, and more efficient.

job.title: SEO/AEO Content Operations Manager

Support the operational uptime and reliability of an autonomous vehicle fleet as an on-site technical expert in Atlanta. The Fleet Support Engineer serves as the primary point of contact for real-time sensor-related escalations, partnering closely with Vehicle Technicians and Component and Hardware Engineering teams to diagnose complex issues, improve troubleshooting processes, and reduce vehicle downtime.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong sensor and vehicle systems expertise with a hands-on, analytical approach to root cause investigation. You will review fleet and sensor data, validate new hardware, develop diagnostic procedures, and implement fleet-wide countermeasures that improve vehicle performance and reliability.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in transportation, aerospace, or autonomous vehicles, with a focus on perception systems and sensors
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
  • Experience with low- and high-voltage circuits and Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS)
  • Knowledge of safe electrical and vehicle troubleshooting practices
  • Understanding of hardware and software system architecture and vehicle communications
  • Ability to conduct comprehensive log reviews and perform in-depth root cause analysis
  • Ability to interpret schematics, electrical diagrams, connector end views, and pinouts
  • Ability to troubleshoot high-level vehicle functions and isolate issues to individual components
  • Experience developing diagnostic procedures and troubleshooting documentation
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills
  • Self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently in an operational environment
  • Ability to document technical findings clearly and accurately

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience remotely supporting vehicle troubleshooting
  • Knowledge of vehicle systems and diagnostic tools
  • Experience with Linux and Python-based systems for fleet-level data processing

  • Familiarity with networking, TCP, and socket programming
  • Experience with sensor calibration, data integrity validation, or hardware bring-up

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: Engineering Technician- Powertrain Systems
job.description:
Engineering Technician – Powertrain Systems

Overview

Support the development of advanced electric and autonomous mobility systems as an Engineering Technician on a powertrain systems team. This hands-on role focuses on preparing, troubleshooting, and maintaining electrical testing hardware, EV wire harnesses, power electronics, and battery-testing equipment in a fast-paced engineering laboratory.

You will work closely with design engineers to develop effective test systems, support embedded hardware updates, maintain lab readiness, and perform servicing and repair activities safely and methodically. This is an opportunity for a technically skilled professional who is passionate about electric vehicles, electrical systems development, and bringing innovative mobility technologies from development into production.

Required Skills

  • Experience preparing, building, and troubleshooting electrical testing hardware to the component level.
  • Ability to perform approved high-voltage enable and disable procedures.
  • Hands-on experience making, updating, repairing, and fabricating wire harnesses for electric vehicles or automotive systems.
  • Ability to solder, crimp, strip, and fabricate harnesses.
  • Ability to read wire harness drawings, schematics, circuit lists, product documentation, and work instructions.
  • Understanding of basic diagnostic processes.
  • Experience maintaining and repairing power electronics and low-voltage PCBA circuits.
  • Experience with electric drive motors, high-voltage batteries, and high-voltage cabling.
  • Experience using a variety of test and measurement equipment, such as:
  • Bipolar power supplies, electronic loads, and DAQ systems
  • AC and DC hookup, function, and compliance equipment
  • Oscilloscopes and digital multimeters
  • Rogowski and Hall sensors
  • Load cells, strain gauges, accelerometers, and LVDTs
  • Pressure transducers
  • Thermocouples, thermocouple welding equipment, RTDs, and thermistors
  • Arbin systems
  • RF/EMF meters
  • Ability to support laboratory readiness by maintaining inventory, organized workspaces, tools, and test and measurement equipment.
  • Ability to perform firmware updates on embedded hardware systems in laboratory and field environments.
  • Ability to carry out servicing and repair operations safely and methodically after appropriate training.
  • High-voltage and low-voltage safety training.
  • Passion for electric mobility, autonomous mobility, and electrical systems development.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with manual metal fabrication tools and processes, including milling, lathe work, drilling, punching, pressing, bandsawing, shearing, or welding.
  • Familiarity with TIG and MIG welding.
  • Experience with 3D design tools such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or CATIA.
  • Through-hole and SMA soldering or rework experience.
  • Exposure to EMI/EMC testing techniques.
  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 Certified Standards Expert certification.
  • High-voltage certification or additional high-voltage training.
  • Soldering certification.
  • Experience supporting battery testing, teardown, and analysis.
  • Experience collaborating with design engineers to develop test systems tailored to engineering needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Associate degree or trade school certificate in mechatronics, electronics, automotive engineering, electrical engineering technology, or another relevant field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Four or more years of experience related to automotive wire harnesses, electric vehicle systems, power electronics, or a similar technical discipline.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Foster City, California.
  • Travel: Local and domestic travel may be required occasionally.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Assignment length: Approximately six months.
  • Ability to work safely in an engineering laboratory and follow applicable high-voltage, low-voltage, and equipment-safety procedures.

job.title: Network Engineer - Corporate & Datacenter
job.description:
Network Engineer - Corporate & Datacenter

This pivotal role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and operate scalable, secure, and reliable network solutions that support a worldwide workforce and mission-critical operations. Preferred Education and Experience:

Other Requirements:

  • This is a W2 role, onsite in Palo Alto, CA
  • No travel expected
  • Ability to leverage AI-driven tools for network management and automation

Elevate your career by contributing to a high-caliber organization committed to technological excellence and innovation in network infrastructure.

job.title: Security Governance Compliance Analyst
job.description:
Security Governance Compliance Analyst

Overview

Support the organization’s information security program by strengthening governance, risk management, and compliance practices across a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The Security Governance Compliance Analyst will lead security audits, conduct risk assessments, maintain compliance documentation, and partner with teams across the organization to ensure alignment with established security policies, standards, and frameworks.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape effective control environments, identify and prioritize security risks, and develop remediation strategies that support organizational resilience and measurable security outcomes.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience conducting security control assessments, compliance assessments, or security audits.
  • 5+ years of experience working with information security standards and privacy laws, such as:
  • NIST 800-53
  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
  • ISO 27001
  • GDPR
  • CCPA
  • CPRA
  • Strong knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance frameworks and tools.
  • Proficiency with risk assessment methodologies and tools.
  • Experience planning and leading organization-wide security audits.
  • Ability to coordinate internal and external audits with IT, Product Security, and other teams.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and maintaining compliance documentation.
  • Ability to conduct risk exposure and comparative risk assessments.
  • Strong understanding of risk prioritization based on potential impact and likelihood.
  • Experience developing and implementing remediation plans.
  • Ability to develop and maintain effective security control frameworks.
  • Familiarity with security management tools, including vulnerability scanners, file integrity monitoring, and configuration monitoring.
  • Familiarity with perimeter security technologies, including routers, firewalls, web proxies, and intrusion prevention systems.
  • Comfortable working with artificial intelligence, machine learning, and large language models.
  • Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple departments in a changing environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in automotive, aerospace, industrial control systems, SCADA, or other high-assurance environments.
  • Experience identifying gaps in platform security and compliance processes.

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: Incoming Quality Control Technician
job.description:
Incoming Quality Control Technician

Join Our Innovative Team as an Incoming Quality Control Technician and help us uphold the highest standards of safety, reliability, and performance in autonomous delivery systems. This dynamic role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology, ensuring the quality of critical components and materials that drive our mission forward. If you are meticulous, detail-oriented, and passionate about quality assurance, this position is your chance to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing industry.

What You’ll Do:

  • Operate incoming-material structural-test equipment, executing load-and-stress protocols on received components.
  • Conduct comprehensive part inspections, including dimensional, visual, and functional assessments utilizing precision tools.
  • Perform detailed inspections of carbon fiber parts, identifying delaminations, voids, or deviations from specifications.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings and blueprints to determine inspection requirements and GD&T callouts.
  • Develop and refine inspection processes, selecting proper measurement tools and deciding inspection scope.
  • Document inspection data accurately within the quality-management system, maintaining strict traceability.
  • Identify nonconformances, apply hold tags, and collaborate with Quality Engineering and suppliers for root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing inspection plans, reducing cycle times, and standardizing best practices.

Required Skills:

  • Proven experience with hand tools for precision measurement, especially calipers and micrometers.
  • Strong visual, dimensional, and functional inspection skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and GD&T callouts.
  • Experience handling composite materials, with bonus points for familiarity with carbon fiber inspection.
  • Data integrity skills, ensuring accurate documentation within quality systems.
  • Background in regulated manufacturing environments such as aerospace, medical devices, or automotive sectors.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with composite materials and their inspection processes.
  • Experience with structural testing equipment and load/stress testing protocols.
  • Knowledge of quality management software and inspection automation tools.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • A minimum of 2 years in quality inspection, preferably in high-precision manufacturing settings.
  • Relevant certifications in quality inspection or technical training in metrology are a plus.
  • An associate degree or technical diploma in manufacturing, engineering, or related fields.

Other Requirements:

  • This is an onsite role based in South San Francisco, requiring physical presence at the manufacturing facility.
  • Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • No travel is required, and prior experience working with composite materials is advantageous.

Embark on a pivotal role that combines precision craftsmanship with innovative technology—become a key player in shaping the future of autonomous delivery solutions.

job.title: UI Designer

Join a dynamic team shaping the future of digital entertainment with an innovative company renowned for pushing creative boundaries.
