job.title: Revenue Accountant
job.description:
Revenue Accountant

Overview

Support a fast-paced Revenue Accounting team as a hands-on Revenue Accountant on a contract basis. This role will help drive accurate, timely, and audit-ready month-end and quarter-end close activities through SOX control workbooks, account reconciliations, revenue validations, collections support, and financial reporting schedules.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of deliverables in a deadline-driven environment. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally to resolve billing and order-to-cash challenges, support accounting projects, and identify opportunities to improve processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and maintain accurate, audit-ready SOX control workbooks, validating data completeness and accuracy through system reports.
  • Execute monthly accounting activities in NetSuite, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and close-related deliverables.
  • Prepare deal and contract summaries for significant transactions in accordance with ASC 606.
  • Support revenue close validations by pulling, comparing, and reconciling data from NetSuite and Salesforce.
  • Prepare book calculations and tie supporting schedules to the general ledger.
  • Support collections forecasting and accounts receivable management.
  • Assist with quarterly accounts receivable and revenue footnote schedules.
  • Support financial reporting through the preparation of accurate supporting schedules.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing and post-launch validations for new products and services.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to streamline the order-to-cash cycle and resolve billing bottlenecks.
  • Document work thoroughly and ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
  • Communicate questions, blockers, recommendations, and potential timing risks proactively.
  • Contribute to ad hoc accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable, Revenue Accounting, or a related accounting function.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP.
  • Experience with revenue accounting, account reconciliations, journal entries, supporting schedules, and close-related deliverables.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation, and large data sets.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing SOX control workpapers that can stand independently under audit review.
  • Ability to understand and articulate the purpose and intent of accounting controls.
  • Experience with collections and analytical accounts receivable activities.
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent track record of reviewing work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple deliverables, and meet recurring close deadlines.
  • Proactive, analytical, and adaptable approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and process improvement skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Big Four public accounting experience.
  • CPA certification.
  • Familiarity with ASC 606 and SOX compliance requirements.
  • Experience with NetSuite and Salesforce.
  • Experience with Google Workspace, including Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail, and Calendar.
  • Background in SaaS, public accounting, or a public company environment.
  • Knowledge of SaaS revenue recognition processes.
  • Experience supporting audit preparation, complex reconciliations, quarterly financial statement disclosures, or financial reporting.
  • Experience participating in User Acceptance Testing and post-launch system validations.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in revenue accounting, accounts receivable, or a related accounting function.
  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close processes, revenue recognition activities, financial reporting, or order-to-cash operations.
  • CPA certification and Big Four experience are strongly preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Contract position from 11/09/2026 through 03/17/2027.
  • Hybrid work arrangement based in Palo Alto, California.
  • Required onsite presence Monday through Wednesday each week; remote work is permitted Thursday and Friday.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.
  • Ability to maintain accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready work throughout the engagement.

job.title: Program Manager IV

job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
Production Technician

job.title: SW Engineer, Service Protection
job.description:
SW Engineer, Service Protection

Overview

Join a Platform Engineering team developing technology that helps protect applications and services from suspicious activity. As a SW Engineer, Service Protection, you’ll build, refactor, and scale primarily backend systems designed to identify and block spam, bots, fraud, and denial-of-service (DoS) threats.

Spam prevention will be the immediate priority, with opportunities to address additional service-protection challenges. You’ll help strengthen resilient, high-availability infrastructure while working with C#, Azure technologies, and modern telemetry tools. This role is well suited for an engineer who enjoys improving existing systems, solving complex technical problems, and contributing to security-focused platforms.

Required Skills

  • Strong professional experience in software engineering, particularly backend or cloud-based development
  • Professional experience with C# is ideal; equivalent experience with languages such as Python, Java, or Go may also be considered
  • Experience refactoring, scaling, and improving existing software systems
  • Understanding of threat detection, suspicious-activity identification, or related service-protection concepts
  • Knowledge of spam prevention, network security, or high-availability system design
  • Ability to analyze complex data and develop effective technical solutions
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with bot mitigation, fraud detection, spam prevention, or DoS protection
  • Familiarity with machine learning or AI applications in security
  • Experience working with Azure or other cloud platforms
  • Knowledge of Kusto or Azure Data Explorer
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana
  • Familiarity with web protocols and application-layer security
  • Experience supporting frontend issues or contributing to smaller frontend projects
  • Background building scalable, resilient, and high-availability systems

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Several years of professional experience in software development, backend engineering, cloud engineering, or security-focused development
  • Demonstrated success improving, scaling, or deploying systems that support security, reliability, or high availability

Other Requirements

job.title: Audio Visual Technician

job.title: Sr. Systems Administrator
job.description:
Sr. Systems Administrator

Overview

Join a mission-driven organization advancing bold and equitable climate action as a Sr. Systems Administrator. In this high-impact role, you’ll help architect, secure, automate, and scale the infrastructure that supports a distributed workforce and global operations.

You’ll serve as a senior technical resource across Azure and hybrid-cloud environments, enterprise networks, databases, endpoints, and corporate systems. This position combines strategic infrastructure planning with hands-on administration, Tier 3 troubleshooting, vendor coordination, automation, documentation, and mentorship. Your work will strengthen system resilience, security, performance, and operational efficiency across the organization.

This is a full-time, six-month contract position with potential for extension.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, deploy, and optimize Azure and hybrid-cloud infrastructure for high availability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Manage servers, virtualization platforms, network equipment, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, internet services, and related infrastructure.
  • Administer SQL database environments, including performance, security, backups, recovery, and high-availability capabilities.
  • Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, Infrastructure as Code, and other orchestration tools.
  • Manage enterprise web environments, including IIS, Linux/PHP, and WordPress platforms.
  • Support Mac and Windows workstations, laptops, endpoints, and corporate systems.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for complex infrastructure, systems, networking, endpoint, and corporate technology issues.
  • Manage Jira workflows, ticket escalations, documentation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Implement patching, system hardening, monitoring, backup, encryption, SSL certificate, and disaster recovery processes.
  • Support IT security audit requirements and maintain compliance-focused infrastructure practices.
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and external support partners.
  • Lead system planning, testing, deployment, firmware updates, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
  • Mentor junior IT staff and provide technical training and knowledge transfer.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, equipment inventories, runbooks, and operational procedures.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 6–8+ years of progressive experience in systems administration, infrastructure design, and cloud architecture.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise Windows infrastructure.
  • Proficiency supporting Mac systems, Windows systems, and endpoint environments.
  • Experience with Jira, help desk operations, ticket escalation, and Tier 3 technical support.
  • Strong knowledge of network administration, including VPN, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, and network equipment.
  • Experience with SQL Server administration, database maintenance, backups, recovery, and high availability.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and/or Python scripting for automation and administration.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code or configuration-management tools.
  • Knowledge of IIS, Linux/PHP, WordPress, or comparable enterprise web environments.
  • Experience with system hardening, patch management, security controls, backups, encryption, SSL certificates, and disaster recovery.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • A proactive, service-oriented, collaborative, and helpful approach to problem-solving.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise backup and encryption systems.
  • Experience supporting IT audit and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery testing, failover planning, and high-availability design.
  • Experience managing vendors, contractors, or third-party support providers.
  • Experience mentoring junior IT professionals or leading technical initiatives.
  • Familiarity with remote or distributed workforce environments.
  • Experience in a sustainability-focused, nonprofit, or mission-driven organization.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Relevant education in information technology, computer science, systems administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Formal degree requirements were not specified for this position.
  • Candidates should bring 6–8+ years of progressive experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, and cloud architecture.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with a preference for candidates who can work from the San Francisco Bay Area office as needed.
  • Candidates may also be considered near office hubs in Portland, Oregon; Portland, Maine; or New York, New York.
  • Remote candidates may be considered within eligible U.S. states, including California, Oregon, New York, Washington, Maine, Texas, Colorado, Michigan, Florida, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Virginia, the District of Columbia, Georgia, Utah, and Illinois.
  • Candidates must have pre-existing authorization to work in the United States. Sponsorship and work authorization assistance are not available.
  • Relocation assistance is not provided.

job.title: PCB Engineer
job.description:
PCB Engineer — High-Speed Computing Hardware

Overview

Join a highly technical hardware engineering team developing advanced PCB platforms for next-generation GPU, CPU, and server systems. As a PCB Engineer, you will drive critical design and layout activities while collaborating with Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, Mechanical, Thermal, Packaging, Board Design, and Manufacturing teams. Your work will directly support the development of reliable, manufacturable, high-performance electronic systems.

Required Skills

  • Proficiency with Altium Designer or an equivalent PCB CAD platform
  • Strong expertise in:

  • PCB stack-up development
  • Impedance control
  • Power delivery networks
  • Experience developing design rules and constraints for high-speed interfaces, including PCIe, memory, and SERDES
  • Ability to define ASIC ball-outs, component footprints, component placement, routing strategies, stack-ups, and design constraints

  • Familiarity with ASIC-driven PCB development workflows

job.title: Senior Analyst, Renewals Operations & Analytics
job.description:
Senior Analyst, Renewals Operations & Analytics

Overview

Join a remote Revenue Operations team that connects Renewals, Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Enterprise Systems to strengthen forecasting accuracy and renewal visibility. In this hands-on role, you will build, validate, and maintain the FY’27 Available to Renew (ATR) model while supporting a weekly renewal forecasting cadence.

You will work closely with Renewals leadership, Global Renewals Owners, Customer Success business unit leaders, Sales, and Finance to ensure forecast outputs reflect current business conditions. Your analysis will help leaders understand where the renewal business stands, why forecasts are changing, and where action is needed.

This role is ideal for an analytical problem solver who is comfortable working directly in Salesforce, Snowflake, notebook-based scripting environments, and spreadsheets—and who can translate complex account-level activity into concise, leadership-ready insights.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related go-to-market analytics role
  • Experience owning or building a recurring forecasting process
  • Deep, hands-on fluency with Salesforce and Snowflake, including renewal opportunities, quoting, linking, and diagnosing data issues
  • Working proficiency with Google Colab or a comparable notebook-based scripting environment; Python experience preferred
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting analytics workflows, including tools such as Alteryx
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets modeling skills
  • Ability to build, test, validate, maintain, and document forecasting models and related workflows
  • Experience identifying and resolving linking gaps, debooks, amendment errors, and other data-integrity issues
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain forecast movement and account-level changes through concise narratives
  • Comfort working within a weekly forecasting cadence, even when data requires investigation or remediation
  • Ability to work independently with limited ramp time, manage competing priorities, and document processes thoroughly
  • Strong collaboration skills when partnering with Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, and Finance

Nice to Have Skills

  • Direct experience building or maintaining an Available to Renew (ATR) or comparable renewal-tracking model
  • Experience supporting renewal-risk analysis or a Renewal Save program
  • Background in SaaS or education technology
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization
  • Experience improving forecast accuracy, reducing unlinked data, or strengthening renewal reporting
  • Experience preparing account-level analysis and written deal summaries for leadership review

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in renewals, revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market analytics
  • Demonstrated experience developing or maintaining forecasting models and recurring reporting processes
  • Professional experience using Salesforce, Snowflake, Python or notebook-based scripting, Alteryx, Excel, and Google Sheets in a business analytics environment
  • Experience partnering with business leaders and technical teams to improve data quality, reporting workflows, and operational processes
  • A specific degree or certification is not required; relevant hands-on experience is valued

Other Requirements

  • Remote position
  • Immediate availability preferred to support an ASAP start
  • Open-ended contract engagement, with the potential for extension, conclusion, or conversion to a full-time position based on business needs
  • Ability to support a consistent weekly forecasting cadence
  • Ability to build, validate, and document the FY’27 ATR model for ongoing team use

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Post-Sale
job.description:

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer

Overview

Join a pioneering engineering team in Mountain View, CA, as an Electrical Design Engineer focused on developing high-performance electrical systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll design and optimize circuits across power, control, mixed-signal, and high-speed interconnect domains while helping bring complex hardware from concept through production.

You’ll contribute to circuit prototyping, board bring-up, signal and power integrity, system troubleshooting, and cross-functional hardware integration. This is an opportunity to work on challenging hardware projects and help deliver reliable, high-performance products.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong proficiency in schematic capture and electrical design using Altium or equivalent EDA software
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory experiments, physical board bring-up, hardware debugging, and signal testing
  • Strong knowledge of circuit design for high-performance applications
  • Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflows and tools such as Arena
  • Ability to design, test, troubleshoot, and document complex electrical systems
  • Experience developing and executing test plans for board-level and full-system performance
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams, component vendors, and contract manufacturers

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience designing high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, or SerDes
  • Background in electrical systems for networking, photonics, or other high-performance hardware applications
  • Solid understanding of Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), and Design for Excellence (DfX) principles
  • Experience using Python or other scripting languages for lab test automation and tool integration
  • Familiarity with electronic manufacturing, assembly, and test methodologies
  • Experience taking hardware designs through prototyping, validation, and production
  • Experience evaluating components, emerging technologies, and hardware development processes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Proven track record of designing and debugging complex electrical hardware for high-speed, high-performance systems
  • Experience bringing hardware from initial concept through prototyping, validation, and production

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Mountain View, CA
  • Strong hands-on laboratory capabilities and a willingness to work directly with hardware are required
  • Ability to collaborate with internal engineering teams, external vendors, and manufacturing partners
  • Immediate availability is preferred
  • Position type: 4-month contract-to-hire opportunity

job.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
Join Our Team as a Senior AI/ML Engineer

Are you passionate about pioneering advanced AI and machine learning solutions that drive innovation? We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer to lead the development of cutting-edge agent orchestration systems and transformative workflows. This role plays a vital part in building scalable, reliable AI platforms that empower enterprise-level applications in a fully remote setting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize multi-agent orchestration workflows, including prompt templating, intent routing, and conversation memory, using Python, asyncio, and FastAPI.
  • Integrate and standardize Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools across various enterprise products.
  • Build automated evaluation pipelines to benchmark LLM accuracy, routing, and latency, ensuring high standards in performance and compliance.
  • Implement dynamic gating and entitlement routing to support secure, multi-tenant environments.
  • Develop telemetry, monitoring, and logging solutions for system observability using Datadog, Snowflake, and OpenTelemetry.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with Python, including high-throughput, asynchronous service development.
  • 2+ years building production-class LLM applications, with expertise in agent workflows, function calling, and multi-agent protocols such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
  • Deep understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), RESTful API design, and orchestration architectures.
  • Proven experience designing automated evaluation and benchmarking strategies for LLMs.
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/Kafka), vector databases, and data warehouses like Snowflake.
  • Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing, automation, and team collaboration.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior experience in enterprise SaaS or tax/compliance technology domains.
  • Knowledge of streaming architectures, semantic caching, and latency optimization.
  • Understanding of IAM/RBAC models and enterprise security standards such as SOC 2, ISO.

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven track record in leading complex AI/ML projects and working within fast-paced tech environments.

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is fully remote with no travel requirements.
  • Availability to start around November 30th for a 1-year engagement.
  • W2 employment status only; no monetary details provided here.

Elevate your career by contributing to innovative AI platforms that shape the future of enterprise intelligence.

job.title: Executive Recruiter
job.description:
Executive Recruiter

Elevate your career by leading transformative executive searches across key organizational functions in a dynamic, remote setting. As an integral partner to C-level and senior leaders, you'll drive strategic talent acquisition efforts that shape the future of a forward-thinking organization. This role offers the opportunity to influence high-impact hiring decisions, craft exceptional candidate experiences, and utilize cutting-edge AI tools to streamline complex recruiting processes—all while maintaining the utmost professionalism and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead full-cycle searches for senior leadership roles across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, and Customer Operations.
  • Partner directly with executive stakeholders to define role requirements, success metrics, and hiring strategies.
  • Conduct comprehensive interviews to evaluate leadership capabilities, cultural fit, and organizational readiness.
  • Develop data-driven and inclusive search strategies to ensure diverse candidate slates.
  • Prepare insightful, polished candidate summaries and provide strategic recommendations to senior management.
  • Maintain clear and confident communication throughout the process, providing market insights and progress updates.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to enhance outreach, scheduling, and documentation, while delivering personalized candidate engagement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless, consistent leadership hiring process.
  • Uphold confidentiality and represent the organization’s brand with professionalism in the executive market.

Required Skills:

  • 15+ years of recruiting experience, with 4+ years focused on Director+ or executive-level placements.
  • Deep understanding of leadership assessment, organizational structures, and business context.
  • Proven influence and advisory capabilities with senior leaders.
  • Exceptional interviewing, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, and AI-enhanced recruiting tools (e.g., ChatGPT, automation assistants).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into executive-ready updates.
  • Professional maturity, sound judgment, and a polished demeanor.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience in a global company or retained/executive search firm.
  • Familiarity with AI and automation technologies beyond core recruiting tools.

Preferred Education and Experience:

Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to leverage advanced recruiting tools and maintain high standards of confidentiality and professionalism.
  • No travel required.

Join us in transforming leadership talent acquisition—where strategic vision meets innovative talent solutions.

job.title: UKG Scheduling Systems Analyst
job.description:
UKG Scheduling Systems Analyst

Join a pioneering team shaping the future of autonomous transportation as a UKG Scheduling Systems Analyst. This critical role focuses on leveraging your expertise in workforce management systems, particularly UKG Pro Advanced Scheduling, to optimize scheduling configurations and improve operational efficiency. As a key member of the Workforce Management team, you will help identify gaps, recommend improvements, and ensure the scheduling system accurately supports the company's dynamic needs in a hybrid environment in Foster City, CA.

What You Will Do:

  • Assess and analyze the current UKG Advanced Scheduling setup, pinpointing inefficiencies and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Collaborate with Workforce Management colleagues and schedulers to translate operational needs into system configurations.
  • Support the implementation, testing, and validation of configuration changes to ensure optimal performance.
  • Document system configurations, testing outcomes, and improvement recommendations for ongoing team use.
  • Utilize forecasting and operational data to evaluate scheduling outcomes, develop reports, and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Perform targeted analysis to support scheduling improvements and related workforce initiatives.

Required Skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience configuring or optimizing UKG Pro Workforce Management Advanced Scheduling.
  • Ability to assess existing scheduling systems, identify improvements, and validate outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of workforce forecasting, capacity planning, and translating operational requirements into system configurations.
  • 3–5 years of experience in workforce management, operations analytics, or similar fields.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with an eye for detail and data integrity.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with other workforce management tools such as NICE.
  • Background in large-scale, 24/7 service environments, fleet operations, or contact centers.
  • Detailed knowledge of workforce management platforms beyond UKG.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, Business, or related fields.
  • Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Other Requirements:

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the efficiency of a forward-thinking operation, supporting cutting-edge autonomous transportation technology through expert workforce management.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Quote-to-Cash

job.title: Estimator
job.description:
Estimator – Electric Utility Construction

Overview

Support the planning and delivery of complex electric utility construction projects as an Estimator in a hybrid consulting engagement based in Massachusetts. This role is responsible for developing accurate, defensible cost estimates across the full project lifecycle, including engineering, materials, permitting, environmental compliance, construction labor, equipment, and project risk.

You’ll collaborate with engineering, project management, construction teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to validate assumptions, resolve estimating challenges, evaluate project risks, and improve cost visibility. Candidates may be considered at the Estimator, Senior Estimator, or Lead Estimator level based on their experience and qualifications.

Required Skills

  • Experience developing comprehensive estimates for electric utility construction or infrastructure projects
  • Knowledge of construction means and methods, project costs, and fundamental engineering principles
  • Ability to review engineering designs, drawings, site conditions, construction plans, contractual requirements, and supporting documentation
  • Experience evaluating capital project risks and recommending appropriate contingency levels
  • Ability to manage multiple estimating assignments, priorities, and deadlines independently
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, project management, construction, vendors, and other cross-functional teams
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as required

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with electric utility construction or infrastructure projects
  • Background in construction estimating, utility project management, or project risk management
  • Experience developing estimates for large, complex capital projects
  • Familiarity with Sage Estimating or comparable estimating software
  • Experience with risk registers, quantitative risk assessments, contingency development, or Monte Carlo simulations
  • Experience comparing estimated costs and schedules with actual project results to improve future estimates
  • Previous consulting or contract experience in an engineering, construction, infrastructure, or utility environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Finance, or a related field; or
  • Associate degree with at least two years of relevant experience; or
  • At least five years of relevant professional experience and training in place of a degree
  • Professional experience in estimating, project cost analysis, utility construction, or a related field

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with onsite responsibilities based in Massachusetts
  • Engagement type: Consulting/contract
  • Ability and willingness to travel to project sites when required
  • Candidates may be considered at the Estimator, Senior Estimator, or Lead Estimator level based on experience and qualifications

job.title: Hardware Engineer - Test Development
job.description:
Hardware Engineer - Test Development

Join a pioneering team at the forefront of vehicle technology as a Hardware Engineer specializing in Test Development. This critical role offers the opportunity to shape the future of automotive hardware systems by developing robust testing methodologies, collaborating with leading suppliers and engineers, and ensuring the highest standards of hardware performance for cutting-edge vehicles. If you're passionate about innovation, detail-oriented, and ready to make an impact, this is your chance to be part of an exciting journey.

Role Overview:

As a Hardware Engineer in Test Development, you will develop and execute comprehensive testing strategies for hardware components at both the system and module levels. Working onsite in Foster City, you'll utilize advanced testing equipment to characterize, validate, and improve hardware performance and reliability for vehicle-use applications. Your contributions will be essential in bridging design concepts with real-world functionality through meticulous testing and infrastructure development, supporting the advancement of autonomous vehicle technology.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in electronics or hardware testing
  • Strong proficiency with oscilloscopes, network analyzers, environmental chambers, and other electrical/environmental test equipment
  • Hands-on experience developing test setups from block diagrams, BoMs, and test plans
  • Skilled in developing custom test assets such as load simulators, test harnesses, and automation scripts in Python
  • Knowledge of PCB design tools (Altium preferred), 3D modeling (3DExperience or Catia preferred)

  • Ability to review and draft test plans, design reviews, and data reports

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience testing automotive, aerospace, or vehicle electronic components
  • Advanced knowledge of Ethernet switch chipsets (Broadcom, Marvell), PCIe, CAN, SPI, I2C, MDIO protocols
  • Experience with simulation tools such as Ansys and requirements management tools like Polarion
  • Understanding of systems architecture, networking, and vehicle communication protocols
  • Background with data acquisition systems (UEI, Keysight) and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence)
  • Participation in team competitions such as SAE, FIRST, or DARPA programs

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Engineering or related disciplines
  • 2+ years of hands-on work in electronics development and testing
  • Experience working with early prototypes and qualification testing for vehicle applications

Other Requirements:

  • On-site presence required in Foster City (5 days/week)
  • Ability to collaborate across teams, suppliers, and design engineers
  • Enthusiastic, innovative self-starter prepared to tackle challenging projects

Embark on a career defining role where your expertise will support groundbreaking advancements in autonomous vehicle technology—apply now to be part of this innovative engineering team.

job.title: Ads Policy Coordinator
job.description:

Join a dynamic, global team dedicated to creating a safe and positive advertising experience for millions of members. job.title: Sr. Payroll Specialist
job.description:

A growing organization in San Jose is seeking a detail-oriented Sr. Payroll Specialist to support accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations across multiple states. job.title: Sr Productivity Platform Developer - Asana
job.description:
Senior Productivity Platform Developer – Asana

Overview

Lead the design, governance, and evolution of an enterprise Asana platform that helps teams plan, track, and deliver work with greater clarity, accountability, and efficiency. As the primary technical owner and architect, you will build scalable workflows, reusable templates, automations, integrations, and governance standards that support cross-functional teams across the organization.

This high-impact role is ideal for a hands-on platform expert who combines systems design, business process optimization, technical configuration, and stakeholder partnership. You will collaborate with Engineering, Datacenter Operations, IT, Security, and Identity teams to translate complex business requirements into secure, maintainable, and easy-to-use Asana solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture, governance, and continuous improvement of the Asana and Unito platforms.
  • Establish standards for organization, teams, portfolios, projects, custom fields, templates, naming conventions, data quality, and platform usage.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes and translate requirements into scalable Asana solutions.
  • Design and implement cross-functional workflows using projects, templates, forms, rules, approvals, custom fields, and portfolios.
  • Serve as the primary Asana administrator and subject-matter expert.
  • Manage global settings, security controls, user provisioning and deprovisioning, licensing, permissions, and sharing models.
  • Build and maintain automations and integrations with tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, email, Jira, Salesforce, GitHub, and internal applications.
  • Use APIs, webhooks, and workflow automation platforms to orchestrate cross-system processes.
  • Collaborate with Security and Identity teams to support SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, multifactor authentication, least-privilege access, and auditability.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting, and usage analytics to measure adoption, data quality, capacity, and workflow effectiveness.

job.title: Payroll/Staff Accountant Consultant
job.description:

  • Working knowledge of general accounting principles, journal entries, general ledger activity, reconciliations, and month-end close processes
  • Experience with payroll systems and accounting software
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, and Adobe Acrobat
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential payroll, employee, and financial information
  • Proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to manage responsibilities across payroll and accounting

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Administration

  • Process accurate and timely payroll for multiple legal entities

  • Prepare payroll-related reports for management and the Finance team
  • Support payroll-related general ledger transfers, month-end close activities, and audit requests

Staff Accounting and Financial Reporting

  • Maintain vendor and customer master data within the accounting system
  • Assist with journal entries, banking transactions, and other general accounting activities
  • Support equity-related administrative and accounting processes, including transfer agent documentation and stock issuance activities
  • Assist with quarterly and annual financial reporting, including tie-outs and supporting schedules for regulatory filings
  • Contribute to month-end and year-end close activities
  • Assist with additional accounting projects as needed

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Paylocity and Microsoft Dynamics
  • Familiarity with BlackLine or similar financial close and reconciliation tools
  • Experience supporting audits, year-end reporting, and payroll-related financial reporting
  • Knowledge of benefits administration, leave management, or HRIS platforms
  • Experience with multi-state or union payroll
  • Experience supporting equity-related accounting or administrative processes
  • Ability to independently prioritize competing responsibilities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is required
  • 5–8 years of professional payroll and accounting experience preferred
  • Experience with complex payroll structures and multiple legal entities is highly valued

Other Requirements

  • Location: Cupertino, CA
  • Work Arrangement: Fully onsite five days per week; remote and hybrid work are not available
  • Employment Type: Contract-to-hire
  • Duration: 3+ months, with potential to transition to a permanent position

  • Travel: No specific travel requirements

job.title: Sr. Payroll Analyst

This role partners with Payroll, HR, Finance, People Technology, regional teams, and external providers to troubleshoot complex issues, support payroll systems and integrations, contribute to cross-functional projects, and drive continuous process improvement.

  • Partner with CloudPay, ADP, and other payroll providers to investigate issues, validate outputs, track action items, and support service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation, process maps, standard operating procedures, controls, and issue logs.
  • Analyze payroll data, system outputs, and trends to identify discrepancies, risks, control gaps, and opportunities to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Support payroll integrations and data flows between Workday, payroll providers, time systems, HR systems, and Finance systems.
  • Assist with compliance, audit, and control activities by preparing reports, gathering evidence, and coordinating responses.
  • Collaborate with regional payroll partners and stakeholders to support consistent global processes while accounting for local requirements.
  • Participate in vendor governance activities, including service reviews, issue tracking, escalation follow-up, and performance reporting.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Provide global payroll coverage as business needs require.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in payroll, payroll operations, HR operations, Finance operations, or a related analytical function.
  • Experience supporting payroll processes in a global or multi-country environment.
  • Experience with Workday Payroll or CloudPay is required.
  • Experience working with a managed payroll provider such as CloudPay or ADP.
  • Working knowledge of payroll systems, payroll providers, data interfaces, and payroll controls.
  • Experience with Workday, including exposure to configuration, business processes, reporting, or testing.
  • Proficiency with Google Suite.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to payroll accuracy.
  • Ability to ramp quickly, work independently with minimal direction, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and follow work through to completion.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and initiative to investigate issues, identify root causes, and pursue solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate across regions, functions, and time zones.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, migrations, system enhancements, or other cross-functional projects.
  • Experience with payroll or HR system configuration, integrations, testing, or release management.
  • Knowledge of OneSource Virtual (OSV) or similar payroll service and vendor environments.
  • Experience with payroll reporting, reconciliations, audit support, and internal controls.
  • Familiarity with global payroll compliance concepts and country-specific payroll requirements.
  • Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, or business intelligence platforms for data analysis and process automation.
  • Payroll certification or progress toward a relevant professional certification.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Experience supporting multi-country payroll operations and third-party payroll relationships.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment requiring sound judgment, independent ownership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Other Requirements

  • This is a 100% remote position.
  • The engagement is expected to last 6+ months.
  • Must be able to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of assigned workstreams.
  • Flexibility to provide global payroll support, including coverage for international regions, as business needs require.

job.title: Senior Manager, SAP Project Accounting
job.description:
Senior Manager, SAP Project Accounting

Overview

Lead the transformation of internal project accounting within a complex SAP S/4HANA environment. As a hands-on Senior Manager, you will design and implement a consistent, scalable framework for tracking project investments, labor, external funding, capitalization, expenses, settlements, and closeout activities.

As a key member of the Corporate Controllership organization, you will establish governance for how internal projects are structured, tracked, accounted for, and closed in SAP. You will partner with FP&A, project owners, Procurement, IT, Fixed Assets, Payroll, Accounts Payable, and other Finance teams to replace manual tracking with integrated, controlled, and increasingly automated SAP-based processes.

This role is ideal for an experienced accounting and SAP professional who can translate accounting requirements into system functionality, guide implementation activities, support testing and deployment, and drive continuous improvement. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly in SAP S/4HANA and providing practical leadership rather than high-level oversight alone.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, particularly:
  • SAP Project System (PS)
  • Controlling (CO)
  • Financial Accounting and General Ledger (FI)
  • Fixed Assets (FI-AA)
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, configuring, or operating SAP project accounting processes.
  • Expertise with project and WBS structures, project cost collection, accounting attributes, capitalization, settlement, reconciliation, and project close.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP related to:
  • Internally developed software
  • Cloud computing arrangements
  • Fixed assets
  • Capitalizable internal projects
  • Project expenses, write-offs, and abandoned projects
  • Experience determining when to use WBS elements, internal orders, cost centers, and other SAP controlling objects.
  • Ability to establish governance for project creation, cost classification, capitalization, settlement, and closeout.
  • Experience supporting monthly and quarterly close activities, including accruals, reconciliations, financial statement analysis, and project-related journal entries.
  • Strong understanding of the integration between project accounting and Procurement, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Payroll, expense management, cost centers, internal orders, and the General Ledger.
  • Experience partnering with SAP functional and technical teams on system design, configuration, testing, deployment, and issue resolution.
  • Experience developing test scenarios, validating accounting results, resolving defects, and supporting user acceptance testing.
  • Demonstrated ability to reduce manual journal entries, reconciliations, and offline project tracking through process improvement and automation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project-management, communication, and stakeholder-influence skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Accounting, FP&A, IT, Procurement, project owners, and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience leading an SAP S/4HANA implementation or large-scale finance transformation.
  • Experience with SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of SAP modules that interface with project accounting, including Materials Management (MM) or Sales and Distribution (SD).
  • Experience with internally developed software and technology project accounting.
  • Familiarity with automation technologies and opportunities to streamline accounting operations.
  • Experience developing project accounting policies, procedures, training materials, and process documentation.
  • Experience supporting SOX controls, internal audits, and external audits related to project accounting.
  • Experience developing reporting and analytics that provide visibility into project actuals, accounting status, capitalization, and financial performance.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • 10+ years of relevant accounting and finance experience.
  • Experience serving as a hands-on Senior Manager or accounting systems leader in a technology-driven, transformation-oriented environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, IT, FP&A, Procurement, Fixed Assets, and business project teams.

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid work arrangement requiring 2–3 days onsite in the South Bay area.
  • Anticipated start timeframe is late December or early January.
  • Potential for the position to transition from contract to full-time.
  • Must be comfortable working hands-on in SAP S/4HANA and guiding implementation activities rather than providing only high-level oversight.
  • Must be able to develop policies, controls, documentation, and training that support consistent adoption across the organization.
  • Must be able to partner with stakeholders to establish accurate project actuals for forecasting, financial planning, management reporting, and financial close.
  • Occasional travel may be required for system deployment or project activities.

job.title: Security Hardening - identity/access/hardening
job.description:
Security Hardening Specialist – Identity, Access & Application Hardening

Overview

Join a mission-critical IT security hardening program focused on strengthening identity, access, application security, and logging across hundreds of applications and cloud services. In this fully remote engagement, you will help eliminate standing administrative access, close local-account vulnerabilities, enforce modern authentication standards, and validate security monitoring coverage.

Working alongside internal IT and security teams and application owners, you will execute standardized, evidence-based hardening procedures prioritized by risk. Your work will help establish a consistent, measurable, and defensible security posture through single sign-on, phishing-resistant MFA, just-in-time access, privileged access management, least-privilege controls, and SIEM-integrated logging.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inventory and eliminate standing administrator access across in-scope applications.
  • Implement or expand just-in-time access, approval, and logging workflows.
  • Identify and close local, unmanaged, or break-glass accounts that bypass SSO and MFA.
  • Reduce excessive administrative privileges and strengthen identity platform controls.
  • Enforce SSO and MFA across SaaS applications.
  • Evaluate and implement SAML and SCIM integrations.
  • Standardize security groups, roles, and permissions using least-privilege principles.
  • Configure application and identity logs for SIEM monitoring.
  • Establish access policies, exception registers, and recurring access reviews or certifications.
  • Partner with application owners and internal IT and security teams to complete remediation activities.
  • Document findings, ownership, remediation steps, and evidence of completion.
  • Track structured security work and progress in Jira or a comparable platform.
  • Validate, retire, or decommission inactive, duplicate, or test applications when appropriate.
  • Prioritize work according to defined risk tiers and maintain consistent hardening standards across the application portfolio.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience administering Okta or a comparable identity provider.
  • Strong knowledge of identity and access management, access governance, and IGA practices.
  • Experience implementing just-in-time access, privileged access management, and administrative access controls.
  • Proficiency with SAML, SCIM, federation protocols, and SaaS application onboarding.
  • Experience enforcing SSO and MFA while identifying and disabling local or unmanaged accounts.
  • Expertise in role and permission right-sizing using least-privilege principles.
  • Experience establishing access policies, exception registers, and recurring access reviews or certifications.
  • Hands-on experience hardening SaaS applications and integrating them with an identity provider.
  • Ability to configure application logging and document security monitoring coverage.
  • Strong documentation skills, including the ability to maintain clear evidence of completed security controls.
  • Experience tracking structured security work in Jira or a comparable project management platform.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with application owners, IT teams, and security stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Opal or a comparable access governance and just-in-time access platform.
  • Familiarity with Workday or other HRIS-driven joiner, mover, and leaver processes.
  • Experience integrating application and identity logs with a SIEM.
  • Knowledge of continuous logging validation and security monitoring coverage.
  • Familiarity with cloud security standards and infrastructure components.
  • Experience supporting SOX systems, audit controls, compliance initiatives, or risk-tiered remediation programs.
  • Experience validating, retiring, or decommissioning inactive, duplicate, or test applications.
  • Background managing security hardening initiatives across a large application portfolio.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
  • Several years of experience in identity and access management, application security, security hardening, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale security projects using standardized, evidence-based procedures.
  • Track record of delivering measurable security improvements across multiple applications, platforms, or business teams.

Other Requirements

  • This is a fully remote engagement.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evidence-driven environment with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and progress-tracking skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work according to defined risk tiers and maintain consistent remediation standards.
  • Willingness to collaborate closely with internal IT and security teams and application owners.
  • Ability to produce clear evidence demonstrating completed hardening activities and security control coverage.

Job Description
We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance (or Head of Finance) to lead and scale our financial strategy, FP&A, and overall accounting architecture as we grow through our next phase of expansion. Operating in a lean startup environment, this leader will blend high-level financial planning and VC fundraising support with direct oversight of core accounting functions. You will serve as a key strategic advisor to leadership while managing our internal accounting team (including a Senior Accounting Manager/Controller and overseeing relationships with external accounting firms.
Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Finance & FP&A: Own the company’s financial model, long-range planning, budgeting, and monthly variance reporting. Track core SaaS/operating metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR, CAC, LTV, payback, churn) and partner with GTM and Engineering to align spend, ROI, and headcount planning.

Oversee monthly close and manage external resources (e.g., Kruze Consulting) while bringing core functions in-house.

job.title: Staff Accountant - Trade Deductions
job.description:
Staff Accountant
Permanent
Hybrid
Newton

The Staff Accountant safeguards financial accuracy by leading the timely research, validation, and resolution of trade deductions. Operating key touchpoints across Accounting, Sales, and Customer Service, this role suits an analytical problem solver experienced in managing high-volume trade promotions, chargebacks, and short pays in a fast-moving CPG environment.

Trade Deduction Processing & Reconciliation


  • Review remittance advice, customer portals, EDI files, and promo schedules to validate or contest deductions promptly.

  • Categorize deductions (promotions, off-invoice allowances, freight, pricing errors, damages, fines) to ensure correct general ledger accounting.

  • Issue approved credit memos, maintaining complete audit trails for every adjustment.

  • Identify invalid claims, build dispute packages, and partner with customers to recover funds.

  • Utilize trade management systems to calculate monthly accruals and reconcile deductions during month-end close.

  • Perform monthly reconciliations for bottle deposits and broker commissions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Work with Sales and FP&A to verify deductions against contract terms, trade plans, and deal sheets.

  • Coordinate with Supply Chain and Customer Service to investigate freight, damage, and logistics compliance claims.

  • Deliver regular aging updates to internal stakeholders; escalate high-value or stalled disputes.

  • Provide Sales with tailored chargeback documentation and customer deduction reporting.

Reporting & Month-End Close


  • Maintain the trade deduction aging schedule and reconcile it to the general ledger monthly.

  • Calculate accruals and verify reserve balances for open and anticipated deductions.

  • Produce analytical reporting by customer, product line, and claim type to highlight trends for leadership.

  • Support internal and external audit requests related to trade spend and AR balances.

Controls & Process Improvement


  • Enforce internal accounting controls and maintain documentation standards across all workflows.

  • Streamline deduction logging, coding, and recovery procedures to boost resolution speeds.

  • Draft and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for trade deduction handling.

Requirements


  • 2+ years of accounting or finance experience (CPG, food & beverage, or consumer products experience strongly preferred).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • Practical understanding of CPG trade mechanics (scan-backs, bill-backs, MCBs, off-invoice allowances, compliance penalties).

  • Direct experience with credit memo creation, cash application, and general ledger reconciliation.

  • Strong organizational skills to manage high-volume line items without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Clear written and verbal communication for seamless cross-departmental coordination.

  • Intermediate Excel skills (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, data manipulation).

Preferred Qualifications


  • ERP software experience (NetSuite preferred).

  • Familiarity with major retailer/distributor portals (Walmart Retail Link, Kroger, KeHE, UNFI) and EDI formats.

  • Exposure to Trade Promotion Management (TPM) tools or specialized deduction software (e.g., BluePlanner).

job.title: Electrical Engineering Technician
job.description:
Electrical Engineering Technician

Join a cutting-edge team at the forefront of autonomous vehicle technology as an Electrical Engineering Technician. In this pivotal role, you'll be instrumental in building, maintaining, and optimizing the sensor emulation and test infrastructure that ensures our engineering teams can validate hardware and software with precision. Your expertise will directly impact the development and deployment of autonomous systems, working hands-on with hardware, wiring harnesses, and test benches in a dynamic laboratory environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and test wiring harnesses for Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test benches and rack assemblies, translating schematics into reliable, automotive-grade connections with attention to signal integrity and durability.
  • Rack, wire, and organize test assets including compute nodes, network equipment, and power supplies, ensuring a clean and efficient lab layout.
  • Manage daily lab operations—stocking parts, maintaining inventory, organizing tools, and enforcing safety protocols such as ESD and electrical safety standards.
  • Troubleshoot hardware issues, diagnose faults in cables, power supplies, and connections, and collaborate with test engineers to reproduce and resolve system failures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation including wiring diagrams, BOMs, rack layouts, and revision histories to support ongoing projects and audits.

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a lab, bench technician, or data center environment working with hardware.
  • Associate’s degree or vocational/technical certification in electronics or electromechanical technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven track record in wiring harness design and assembly, including creating schematics and pinout diagrams, selecting connectors, and crimping automotive-grade connectors such as Molex, Amphenol, or Rosenberger.
  • Experience racking, cabling servers, and managing structured cabling systems independently.
  • Proficiency with hand tools, torque tools, multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and safe electrical practices, including ESD handling.
  • Ability to lift and handle equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with automotive ECUs, embedded systems, or HIL test benches.
  • Skilled in SMT rework (0402, 0201 BGA), and harness workmanship standards (IPC/WHMA-A-620 or similar).
  • Familiarity with CAD tools like SolidWorks or CATIA for harness design and layout.
  • Basic scripting knowledge (Python, Bash) and Linux command-line proficiency for system verification and automation tasks.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Technical training or certifications in electronics or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with automotive hardware, electronic control units, or test automation environments.

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite presence in Foster City, CA.
  • Ability to work independently and maintain an organized, safe, and efficient lab environment.
  • Willingness to handle physical tasks, including moving equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.

This role offers a fascinating opportunity to contribute to innovative autonomous vehicle development, leveraging your technical expertise in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
About the Company

Our client is a growing, private equity-backed manufacturer of custom packaging solutions for the medical device industry. With approximately $550 million in revenue and 1,675 employees globally, the company supports leading healthcare and medical technology customers with specialized sterile packaging for implants, catheters, and other medical devices.

The company recently acquired a roughly $35 million manufacturing operation in Burlingame with approximately 96 employees. This role will help integrate and strengthen the facility’s finance function while supporting its continued growth.

Position Summary

The Finance Manager will serve as the primary finance partner for the Burlingame facility, with responsibility for financial planning and analysis, management reporting, and accounting close activities.

The role is approximately 75% FP&A and strategic analysis and 25% accounting. It will initially support the Burlingame operation, with the potential to assume responsibility for an additional West Coast facility over time.

This position reports to the Director of FP&A for the Americas and is part of an eight-person FP&A team. The successful candidate will also work closely with the Burlingame Site Director and leaders across operations, sales, supply chain, HR, customer service, and engineering.

This is an opportunity to build and improve the finance function rather than inherit a fully established environment. The person will help strengthen planning, reporting, and accounting processes while supporting the transition from QuickBooks to Visual ERP.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning and Analysis


  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and longer-range planning for the Burlingame facility.

  • Develop and maintain financial models, forecasts, and scenario analyses.

  • Analyze financial performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods.

  • Identify key business drivers, trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Establish and monitor KPIs and other performance metrics.

  • Provide management with actionable financial insights and recommendations.

  • Partner with functional leaders to develop budgets and monitor performance.

  • Support business cases, capital investments, and operational decision-making.

Accounting and Close


  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close activities for the facility.

  • Review financial statements, account reconciliations, and management reporting.

  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records.

  • Maintain appropriate accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

  • Support compliance with GAAP and applicable reporting requirements.

  • Provide limited oversight of accounts receivable and accounts payable activities.

Financial Reporting and Systems


  • Deliver timely and accurate reporting to site and corporate leadership.

  • Prepare variance analyses and explain the key drivers of financial performance.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting packages that improve financial visibility.

  • Improve reporting processes, automation, and data consistency.

  • Help transition the Burlingame operation from QuickBooks to Visual ERP.

  • Support the company’s broader business intelligence and reporting initiatives.

Business Partnership


  • Serve as the primary finance partner to the Burlingame Site Director and functional leadership.

  • Translate financial results into practical insights for non-finance stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with operations, sales, supply chain, HR, customer service, engineering, and other business functions.

  • Help establish greater financial discipline and accountability across the facility.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across FP&A, accounting, and reporting.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.

  • Approximately seven or more years of progressive experience in FP&A, accounting, plant finance, or corporate finance.

  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and accounting close processes.

  • Working knowledge of GAAP and internal controls.

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

  • Experience working with ERP and financial reporting systems.

  • Ability to balance detailed accounting responsibilities with forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to communicate financial information clearly to operational and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable building processes and operating in an evolving environment.

  • High degree of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Manufacturing or plant finance experience.

  • Medical device, healthcare, or regulated manufacturing experience.

  • Experience transitioning or integrating an acquired business.

  • ERP implementation or systems-conversion experience.

  • CPA, CMA, MBA, or another relevant professional certification.

  • Experience improving FP&A, accounting, reporting, or business intelligence processes.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:


  • Accurate and timely financial reporting and accounting close.

  • More effective budgeting and forecasting processes.

  • Improved visibility into business performance and financial drivers.

  • Stronger accounting processes and internal controls.

  • Successful transition from QuickBooks to Visual ERP.

  • Better management of cash flow and working capital.

  • Actionable financial insights that support operational decisions.

  • Continued improvement and automation of finance processes.

job.title: Embedded Systems Security Engineer
job.description:
Join Our Team as an Embedded Systems Security Engineer!

Are you passionate about pioneering security solutions for cutting-edge embedded Linux platforms? We are seeking an innovative and experienced Embedded Systems Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of robust security architectures for next-generation devices. In this pivotal role, you'll bridge the gap between hardware security, kernel hardening, and secure user-space application containment, ensuring our products are resilient, scalable, and secure from the ground up. If you're ready to make a tangible impact on device security at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do:

  • Design and implement Hardware Root of Trust and Secure Boot architectures from the bootloader to the Linux kernel.
  • Develop cryptographically verified read-only filesystems using dm-verity and implement data encryption at rest.
  • Build and maintain Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) like OP-TEE, and develop secure applications.
  • Enforce strict user-space isolation using SELinux, AppArmor, cgroups, namespaces, and seccomp filters.
  • Automate cryptographic signing pipelines within CI/CD workflows, utilizing HSMs or secure key vaults.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing to develop secure device provisioning scripts and validation tools.
  • Architect multi-slot boot recovery systems to enhance system resilience against OTA failures and corruption.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, board bring-up, and BSP customization.
  • 3+ years deploying device-level security features into production hardware.
  • Expertise with bootloader configurations (U-Boot, Barebox) and Linux kernel security subsystems (dm-crypt, dm-verity).
  • Deep understanding of ARM TrustZone architecture (ARMv7-A / ARMv8-A).
  • Proven experience with SELinux/AppArmor policies and Linux containment tools (cgroups, namespaces).
  • Proficiency with embedded build systems like Yocto Project or Buildroot.
  • Strong programming skills in C, with scripting expertise in Python or Bash.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Solid foundation in cryptography, including symmetric/asymmetric algorithms, SHA-256/384, and PKI.
  • Experience working with Contract Manufacturers or factory lines on secure key injection and fuse-burning protocols.
  • Knowledge of embedded container runtimes (LXC, crun) and lightweight sandboxing frameworks.
  • Experience designing anti-rollback protection mechanisms for OTA updates.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical discipline.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in embedded Linux security and development environments.
  • Prior experience with manufacturing scale deployments and security protocols.

Other Requirements:

  • This is an onsite role based in Foster City, CA. Must be willing to work 5 days in the office.
  • No relocation is provided; local candidates preferred.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with manufacturing and engineering teams.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

DeWinter Group and Maris Consulting are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
